SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien“: Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Buchhaltung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Fachwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

Aufgaben

Finanzbuchhaltung & Abschlüsse: Du verantwortest die laufende Finanzbuchhaltung und erstellst Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für komplexe Mandantenstrukturen - unterstützt durch modernste KI- und Automatisierungstools, die Routine minimieren und Tiefe ermöglichen.

Eigenständige Mandantenbetreuung: Du betreust deinen eigenen Mandantenstamm selbstständig und zielorientiert - von der laufenden Buchhaltung bis zum fertigen Abschluss - und baust nachhaltige Beziehungen auf.

Internationale & anspruchsvolle Sachverhalte: Du bildest grenzüberschreitende Geschäftsmodelle korrekt ab und findest dich in international agierenden Unternehmen sicher zurecht.

Entwicklung neuer Prozesse & Leistungen: Du bestimmst mit, wie KI-gestützte Buchhaltung aussieht. Dein Fachwissen + die Unterstützung durch unsere Softwareentwickler = Prozesse und Leistungen, die klassische Kanzleien nicht anbieten können.

Qualifikation

Fachliche Exzellenz: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation - du bist sattelfest in der Rechnungslegung nach HGB.

Erfahrung in komplexen Mandantenstrukturen: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Betreuung anspruchsvoller Mandate, bevorzugt bei E-Commerce- und SaaS-Unternehmen.

Internationales Business: Grenzüberschreitende und international agierende Geschäftsmodelle sind dir vertraut und du bewegst dich darin sicher.

Konzernkenntnisse von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Konzernrechnungslegung ist ein Plus - als Zeichen für die entsprechende fachliche Tiefe und Senioritätsstufe.

Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und zielorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Mandate.

Tech-Begeisterung: Du probierst neue Lösungen aktiv aus, bist bereit, kontinuierlich Neues zu lernen, und siehst Technologie als Hebel - nicht als Bedrohung.

Benefits

🧠 Du baust mit, was Buchhaltung und Beratung morgen sind - KI-gestützte Prozesse und Formate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie moderne Kanzleiarbeit in der Zukunft aussieht

🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe

🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate und Gestaltungsspielraum bei Prozessen und Leistungsportfolio

🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup - Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen

💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

description_html:

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

Deine Mission

KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.

Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.

Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.

Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.

Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.

Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.

Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.

Dein Profil

Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.

KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.

Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.

Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.

KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.

Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.

Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.

Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.

Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein starkes Plus – ebenso Vertrautheit mit Accounting-/Finance-Software-Stacks, DATEV, ELSTER oder regulierten Datenworkflows.

Benefits

  • 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht

  • 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe

  • 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit

  • 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup — Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen

  • 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket + option auf Anteile (VSOP)

  • 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren

  • 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens, top angebunden

  • 🎁 3.000 € p.a. Benefitsprogramm + Firmenhandy

title: GTM Intern - New Products (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Reonic
description_html:
You turn new ideas into revenue at Reonic. Find the opportunity, test it, make it happen.

Looking for a role where you don't just support growth but actually own it? This is for you. You'll work directly with installers to uncover real problems, turn those insights into new products and services, and take them from first idea to go-to-market. Working closely with our Venture Development team, you'll have the freedom and responsibility to figure out what works - and the pace to make it happen.

Please note that for this role, C2 German proficiency is required. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

What You’ll Do

  • Go-to-market for new products and services inside our software. Which installers need this service? How do we reach them? What can we charge? What are the selling points? You don't find the answers at your desk, you find them by trying things.

  • Customer immersion and spotting new revenue streams. Daily conversations with installers to find out where their processes really hurt, pressure-test ideas against reality, and sell what you've built together with the Venture Development team.

  • Commercial responsibility. You figure out which model works: commission, fixed price, bundled pricing, or a partner share. And you see early whether a channel has enough potential to keep pushing.

  • Cross-functional execution. You pull sales, marketing, tech, and external partners together around your topic and keep it moving. You're the one who calls the next step and makes sure it happens.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Native or C2-level German and fluent English.

  • You've already brought something to market, or at least tried: your own project, a campaign, a product during an internship. What matters isn't the outcome, it's that you got going.

  • Strong sense of ownership and impatient if things don't move fast.

  • You'd rather talk to customers than build a theory at your desk.

  • You're comfortable with open situations and get your own answers.

  • Top university background with a clear entrepreneurial streak.

  • First experience in sales, growth, or product is a plus, but not a must.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of one of the fastest growing VC-backed startup in Germany with 3000+ satisfied B2B customers.

  • A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face - we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

  • Enjoy opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • Embrace the freedom to innovate and make quick changes in a dynamic team.

  • Perks include gym membership ,or Deutschlandticket, Uber Eats after 7pm, Uber home after 7:30pm, regular team events, and a MacBook.

  • Receive competitive pay.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back - we value talent and passion above all.


About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for renewable installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3000+ business customers, we’re growing fast - and we need YOU to help us accommodate our new and existing customers.

description_html:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

You will spearhead hardware testing at Orbem. Working side-by-side with MRI, Mechatronics, Compliance, and Software Engineers in Test, you will design rigorous test protocols and execute hands-on validation of every mechanical, electrical, and mechatronic component that ships with our automation and industrialised AI-powered MRI products.

Your day-to-day

  • Define, conduct and document hardware test strategies, protocols and quality gates for our automation systems and industrialized imaging unit.

  • Define and create the right environment for in-house testing of sub-systems and components.

  • Collaborate closely with the product development team, supply chain, field engineers and Software integration.

  • Establish and own our QMS framework and testing process.

  • Define and conduct testing strategies and protocols to assess our suppliers, visit manufacturing units and perform FATs.

Your responsibilities include:

Defining a long-term testing and quality strategy for our complex systems and building the required team and resources around this.

 
 

Your Experience and Skills

  • You have 5 + years experience in hardware, reliability, mechatronics or system-integration testing and have led a testing team in the past.

  • You have established and enforced quality and testing frameworks for complex systems using top-notch tools.

  • You are hands-on with automation systems, sensors, actuators, oscilloscopes or PLCs.

  • You have proven ability to set objective pass/fail criteria, perform root-cause analysis and request design improvements.

  • You are experienced in writing clear test plans for electro-mechanical interfaces.

 

Fit to our values

  • We own every challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We strive for better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We imagine new frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have a strong background in the food automation industry or worked with medical devices.

  • You turn fuzzy “should work” ideas into measurable metrics and back them with repeatable test frameworks

  • You are proactive, curious and passionate about sustainable, high-impact technology.

What We Offer

International Environment

Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

 

Attractive Compensation Package

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Visa & Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.

 

Work-Life Integration

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + a sleek external monitor on us!

  • Work from Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. title: Principal of Information Security (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Orbem
description_html:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

You will own Orbem’s Information Security function end-to-end at a pivotal moment.

Orbem achieved ISO 27001 certification in December 2025. We are now entering an active stabilization phase: controls are established, our external provider stack is being restructured, and a re-audit sits on the horizon. You will inherit this reality — and the authority to shape it.

This is a role for a hands-on, senior security practitioner who wants to shape a security function, not just run one — someone who thrives in ambiguity, makes high-stakes strategic calls with incomplete information, and can do the operational work themselves while orchestrating a deliberate external provider stack. Although we are looking for a strategist, you will also be required to support day-to-day security operations.

Your Day-to-Day

Strategy & Program Ownership (≈ 40%)

  • Lead our approach to the upcoming ISO 27001 re-audit. Assess the situation, make the strategic recommendation, and own the execution.

  • Set and maintain Orbem’s information security strategy aligned with our stage, our customers (enterprise food today, healthcare in our strategic line of sight), and our risk appetite.

  • Own the information security risk register end-to-end: build it where needed, maintain it, and run the risk review with key leadership peers.

  • Represent Orbem externally with auditors, enterprise customer security teams, and regulators in the CISO capacity.

  • Advise the leadership team on information security risk in product, go-to-market, and expansion decisions, including healthcare readiness planning.

Hands-On Execution (≈ 40%)

  • Own and continuously improve key operational security processes — including how we assess and manage risk across our vendor and supplier base, how security is embedded in key business workflows, and how we ensure controls translate from policy into practice.

  • Bring policies and controls to life. Identify which controls are most material, which to operationalize further, and which to consolidate — in partnership with the teams who will execute them.

  • Own the ISMS governance structure — ensuring that control reviews, evidence collection, management reviews, and internal audits happen to a high standard, whether through direct execution, external support, or a combination.

  • Lead incident response as incident commander for security-relevant events, with the Security Engineering team as technical co-lead.

  • Write clear policies, clear communications, clear decisions. You will author or co-author most of the security-related writing that leaves this function.

Orchestrating the External Stack & Lateral Leadership (≈ 20%)

  • Manage a deliberate external provider stack. You will not build everything in-house. You will orchestrate a set of external partners — examples include audit preparation support, data protection advisory services, a managed security service provider, penetration testing, and an ISMS and compliance management platform. For each, you contribute to the build-vs-buy decision and own the ongoing relationship.

  • Collaborate closely with the Security Engineering team through a close working relationship that connects governance and technical security.

  • Co-build a Security Ambassadors network with the Security Engineering team — empowered technical leads across business teams who champion security in their own context.

  • Leverage AI and automation aggressively across the security programme — compliance evidence collection, vendor review, policy drafting, user training, awareness — to keep the function lean.

How You Fit In

This is an individual contributor role at Principal level. Your influence is lateral, not hierarchical. You will work alongside the General Counsel, the Corporate Operations lead, the Procurement & Supply Chain lead, and the Security Engineering team. You will interact with the full executive team on security-relevant decisions.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Scale-up security leadership experience. You have been the #1 or #2 information security compliance person at a company in the 150–600 FTE range.

  • ISO 27001 lived experience. You have personally guided a company through an ISO 27001 cycle. You can make a credible audit strategy recommendation because you have seen the consequences of each option in practice.

  • Hands-on operator. You have personally set up security processes and controls — not only specified or overseen them. You are comfortable running a security register, writing policies, running workshops, and sitting in working meetings to ship work.

  • Comfort without a large team. You are motivated by being the person in the room, not the person who built the room.

  • Resilience. Security leadership means making hard calls — sometimes unpopular ones, sometimes under time pressure. You are energised by that responsibility, not deterred by it. You stand behind your decisions and own the business outcomes.

  • Communication. You can translate security risk into business decisions for a non-security executive team, and technical specifics for engineers. You write and speak clearly.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience navigating an ISO 27001 re-audit.

  • Familiarity with the European regulatory landscape (GDPR, NIS2, EU AI Act) and a working understanding of US frameworks (SOC 2).

  • Deep-tech, AI/ML, or industrial product context. Our security surface is not SaaS-shaped — edge devices, hardware, industrial customers, imaging data.

  • Experience working with and evaluating external security and compliance service providers.

  • Comfort with AI-first working. We expect you to use AI to compress the work — and to own the output, not just the prompt. You also bring an informed view on how to monitor and govern AI usage internally.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

Compensation: €120K – €135K • €120K – €180K Equity

  • • Compensation Range €120K – €135K • €120K – €180K Equity

Wir verbinden Software mit Fintech und Automatisierung.

Unser Ziel? Selbstständigen Unternehmer:innen den Rücken freizuhalten, damit sie fundierte Entscheidungen treffen und nachhaltig wachsen können.

Wir sind ein internationales, technologiegetriebenes Team, das Verantwortung liebt und Dinge wirklich bewegt.

Hast du Lust, eine ganze Branche auf das nächste Level zu heben?

  • Autonom und strategisch arbeiten: Du planst deine Aktivitäten selbstständig, setzt klare Ziele und findest smarte Wege, um Salonkee erfolgreich vor Ort zu etablieren.

  • Technisches Know-how: Ein gutes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und fundierte Erfahrungen mit CRM-Systemen.

  • Mobil und flexibel: Mit Führerschein und Bereitschaft für Außeneinsätze bist du jederzeit einsatzbereit.

  • Kommunikationsstark: Nahezu muttersprachliches Deutsch und gutes Englisch für den Austausch mit Kunde:innen und Kolleg:innen.

Wir wachsen schnell und suchen dich werde Teil unseres A Teams 🏆

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Sales Development Representative (German Speaking)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sanity
description_html:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

You're early in your sales career and you'd like a product you can actually get curious about. We're hiring a German-speaking SDR to open up conversations with the teams building the next wave of content and AI products in the DACH region.

SDRs are the front door to Sanity. You'll start the conversations that become pipeline, and because we're growing quickly, you'll also help decide how those conversations should go. No script handed down from three years ago.

What you will do

  • Own your pipeline from day one
    You're not waiting for leads to land in your lap. You'll be out there, on the phone, in inboxes, sliding into LinkedIn DMs (professionally), starting real conversations with people who have real problems Sanity can solve. You find them, you qualify them, you build the pipeline.

  • Become the person who gets it
    Sanity isn't your average SaaS pitch. We're selling a new way of thinking about content: treat it like data, so AI and teams can actually do something with it. You'll get deep on the product, then put it in language that makes both developers and execs lean forward. In German and in English.

  • Have a seat at the table
    This isn't a smile-and-dial role. Your frontline conversations shape messaging, strategy and the product roadmap. Marketing wants your feedback. Sales needs your handovers to be tight. Leadership is listening. What you hear on calls travels.

  • Get serious about your craft
    Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn. You'll know your tools cold and use them to run a clean, sharp operation. Good data hygiene isn't glamorous, but it's what separates good SDRs from great ones.

  • Help build something from scratch
    We're growing fast and the playbook isn't finished, because you'll help write it. Spot a better way to run outreach? Say so. We'll try it.

About you

  • You have previous experience in an SDR role or similar, out-bounding prospects, preferably in SaaS

  • You speak fluent German, and English

  • A target motivates you more than it worries you

  • You can talk to a CTO and a CMO on the same afternoon and change gear between them

  • You want to win, and you'd rather the whole team won with you

  • Rejection doesn't stick to you. You know the yes is coming if you stay consistent

  • You spot patterns, not just problems, and you use them to aim better next time

  • You ask for feedback before anyone offers it

Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway!


What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive salary and stock options program

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 200+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Senior Software Developer - Java (all genders)

description_html:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join one of our energetic teams. In this role, you will help drive the growth and development of our Hospitality product group, powering our passion to deliver unmatched reliability, deeper value, and long-term delight for our customers and strengthen our comprehensive commerce platform.

You will be joining the team driving the Lightspeed L- and G-series products, which power hospitality businesses across the globe and help them deliver exceptional guest experiences. Our mission is to stay ahead of customer needs and evolving regulations, while at the same time modernizing our technology stack to ensure these products remain reliable, scalable, and future-ready.

You will join an international, independent and collaborative team, continuously improving our engineering practices, infrastructure and codebase, all while keeping it fun. Most importantly, your work will directly shape the daily experience of business owners and hospitality guests.

Join us in pioneering the future of hospitality technology!

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Working alongside some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, you will contribute to the L&G series product by building new features and improving the developer experience.

  • Balance core duties, spanning from building new features to modernizing our backend technology stack.

  • Report to the Development Manager, maintaining robust interaction with Product Managers, Support Specialists, and Platform Teams.

  • Participate in daily agile ceremonies, ignite innovation that challenges the status quo, and actualize solution-oriented ideas.

  • Advocate for superior code quality and accountability, contributing actively to infrastructure health.

  • Foster growth within your team by disseminating knowledge and best practices, while perpetually striving for advancement and progression.

Feel free to take a look at our Tech Stack here.

What you'll be bringing to the team:

  • Expert Java knowledge with 6+ years in production, including large, long-lived codebases

  • 4+ years of deep Spring Framework experience (IoC, MVC, Security, transactions)

  • 4+ years using advanced SQL: complex queries, indexing, multi-tenant data models, and schema migrations

  • Strong OOP, domain modeling, and design patterns, with judgment about when not to over-engineer

  • A track record of designing and evolving backward-compatible REST APIs

  • A strong advocate for testing, with experience in automated testing frameworks

  • Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines

  • Clear English communication: design reviews, trade-offs, and collaboration with non-technical stakeholders

  • Computer Science degree or equivalent

What will increase your chances:

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment

  • Work in payments, fiscal/compliance, or other high-correctness domains

  • Familiarity with hybrid cloud + on-premise systems

  • Exposure to cloud environments like GCP, AWS, and cloud solutions like Kubernetes, Docker, etc.

  • Experience with Maven multi-module codebases, Jetty/WAR deployments, Redis, WebSockets, or scheduled jobs

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Lots of autonomy and flexible work culture.

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

  • Opportunity to make a difference; help merchants grow their businesses and become more successful by creating or improving products and addressing customer feedback

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Development of very high traffic products, used at a global scale

  • Opportunities to learn and expand your skill set

  • Become a valued part of the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Monthly office lunch

  • Work from anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • Health and wellness benefit of 400 euros per year

  • Mental health online platform and counseling & coaching services

  • Volunteer day

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

In unserer Community soll jedes Mitglied 3 wichtige Menschen für sein echtes Leben finden: Jobtitel sind dir nicht wichtig und du möchtest dazu beitragen, unsere Vision zu erreichen? Wir wollen dich kennenlernen. 

Du bist der Ansicht, du könntest gut zu unserem Unternehmen und in unser Team passen? Dann bewirb dich mit deinen Unterlagen und wir finden gemeinsam heraus, wie und wo wir dich am besten einsetzen können. 


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Wachstum nach deinen Vorstellungen - Ob Fach- oder Führungskarriere: bei uns gestaltest du deinen individuellen Entwicklungspfad mit.

  • Team-Unterstützung durch Gespräche, Coaching, Feedback und Mentoring - Wir leben eine offene Kultur mit ehrlichem, konstruktivem Austausch und starkem Zusammenhalt.

title: Werkstudent*in Review Management & Feedbackanalyse (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aok Connect
description_html:
Bewerbungsfrist

Donnerstag, 01. Oktober 2026


So gestaltest du mit

Wir suchen Verstärkung für unser Team im Review Management: Du beantwortest Rezensionen, wertest Nutzer*innenfeedback aus und machst wiederkehrende Anliegen für unser Team sichtbar.

  • Du sichtest regelmäßig Rezensionen und Nutzer*innenfeedback zu unseren digitalen Angeboten, insbesondere zu unseren Apps, kategorisierst sie nachvollziehbar nach Themen, Anliegen und Stimmungslage und erkennst dabei zentrale Muster, wiederkehrende Hinweise und akute Auffälligkeiten.
  • Du formulierst, prüfst und finalisierst Antworten auf Rezensionen – wertschätzend, verständlich, adressatengerecht und im Rahmen abgestimmter Kommunikationsleitlinien.
  • Du bereitest zentrale Erkenntnisse aus der Auswertung regelmäßig in kurzen Übersichten, Tabellen oder Reports auf und dokumentierst sie so, dass sie für Kommunikation, Support und Produktentwicklung nutzbar werden.
  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung unterstützt du dabei, Antwortbausteine, Kategorien, Auswertungslogiken und Arbeitsabläufe im Review Management weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du bringst Ideen ein, wie digitale Werkzeuge und KI sinnvoll bei Kategorisierung, Antwortentwürfen, Zusammenfassungen und Reporting unterstützen können und prüfst Ergebnisse sorgfältig auf Qualität und Verständlichkeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschriebene*r Student*in an einer Hochschule oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise in den Fachrichtungen Kommunikationswissenschaft, Medien-, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Psychologie, Digital Health oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, und hast mindestens das dritte Semester erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du schreibst sehr sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch und hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und adressatengerechte Kommunikation.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und eigenständig und verbindest kommunikative Stärke mit analytischem Denken – du kannst Rückmeldungen nicht nur beantworten, sondern auch auswerten, einordnen und verständlich zusammenfassen. 
  • Du hast gute Excel-Kenntnisse.
  • Du bist technisch aufgeschlossen, arbeitest dich gern in neue Tools ein und interessierst dich für den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen in Kommunikation, Kundenservice, Community Management oder in der Arbeit mit digitalen Produkten gesammelt.

Du musst nicht alle Punkte vollständig erfüllen – wichtig sind uns vor allem ein gutes Gespür für Sprache und Zielgruppe sowie analytisches Denken.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Wir bieten eine zukunftssichere Tätigkeit bei einem jungen Unternehmen, das für die 27 Mio. Versicherten der AOK die Umsetzung wirksamer digitaler Dienste (wie z.B. der elektronischen Patientenakte) sicherstellt und dabei nachhaltig die Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen vorantreibt.
  • Dazu gibt es eine attraktive Vergütung mit einem Stundenlohn von 18,00 € brutto bei ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen. In Rücksprache mit deinem Team arbeitest du in unserem modernen Büro in zentraler Lage in Berlin oder mobil. Darüber hinaus kommt die ganze Organisation einmal monatlich in Präsenz an unserem Berliner Standort zusammen.
  • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten, die mit einem Jahresarbeitszeitkonto an deine jeweiligen Bedürfnisse angepasst werden können, sowie ein anteiliger Urlaubsanspruch auf Basis von 30 Urlaubstagen bei einer 5-Tage-Woche.


Du hast noch Fragen?

  • Bei Rückfragen zur Ausschreibung oder dem Bewerbungsprozess stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung.
  • Wende dich für Anfragen bitte direkt per Mail an
  • Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben und Lebenslauf) kannst du direkt über den unten stehenden Button "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" über unser Bewerbungsportal einsenden.
  • Alternativ übermittle diese per E-Mail an Datenschutzerklärung zustimmst.


Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

  • Wir stehen für den Inklusionsgedanken. Wir unterstützen daher ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung. Diese werden bei gleicher Eignung und Befähigung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Unser Unternehmen fördert zudem aktiv die Gleichberechtigung und hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, die berufliche Entwicklung von Frauen zu unterstützen.

title: Logistics Manager - Retail & D2C (m/f/d)
description_html:
About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our product lines Energy®, Iced Tea®, Hydration®, Milkshake®, and our newest innovation, the HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.
  • Coordinate display assembly, capacity planning, timelines, and escalations.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: After reviewing your CV, Eric, our Talent Acquisition Manager, will have a 30-minute screening interview with you to discuss more about HOLY and the position and see if our expectations match.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview with Jan: Deep dive into your experience and approach with Jan, our Senior Logistics Manager.
  3. Case study: As soon as you have successfully completed the first 2 interviews, you will receive a case study.
  4. Advanced discussion: In this on-site meeting, the team will discuss your case study with you and answer questions in our office, the HOLY Temple. Here you will also meet Markus, our COO.
  5. Founder interview: As a strong cultural fit is important to us, you will have a final meeting with Fredi, one of our HOLY founders. This gives both you and us the opportunity for a final check.
  6. Job offer and decision: If everything goes well, you will receive an offer and we are ready to embark on this journey together with you!
Typically his process should take around 2 weeks.


Any questions or concerns?

If you have any questions or feedback, please send an email to Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Project Manager Digital Plattform Automotive (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at BBDO Germany
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
  • Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
  • Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
  • Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
  • Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.


Warum wir?

  • Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
  • Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
  • Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
  • Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
  • Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
  • Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
  • Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
  • Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 


Unser Standort

Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria. 

Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer (m/w/d) in Köln
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GRÜNE'S LEIHHÄUSER GmbH & Co. KG
description_html:
Was dich erwartet

Als Azure Infrastructure Engineer verantwortest du hauptsächlich den Aufbau, Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-Cloud-Infrastruktur. Du stellst eine stabile, sichere und hochverfügbare Azure-Plattform bereit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem IT-Team die zukünftige Cloud-Architektur des Unternehmens weiter. Darüber hinaus bist du technischer Ansprechpartner für Microsoft 365 sowie moderne Sicherheitslösungen im Microsoft-Ökosystem und unterstützt die Automatisierung sowie Standardisierung unserer IT-Landschaft. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team aktiv den Weg von einer überwiegend On-Premises geprägten Infrastruktur hin zu einer modernen, sicheren und skalierbaren Azure-Cloud-Umgebung.
Die Position ist in Vollzeit in Köln oder Frankfurt zu besetzen und kann nach Deiner Einarbeitung in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell ausgeführt werden.
Deine Aufgaben:

  • Planung, Betrieb und Optimierung der gesamten Azure-Plattform
  • Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der M365-Services einschließlich Exchange Online, Teams und SharePoint
  • Umsetzung von Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Identity Protection, Conditional Access und Microsoft Defender
  • Administration von Identitäten, Rollen, Gruppen und Authentifizierungsverfahren
  • Entwicklung von PowerShell-Skripten und Automatisierung administrativer Prozesse
  • Überwachung der Azure-Umgebung, Analyse von Leistungskennzahlen sowie Kapazitätsplanung
  • Mitarbeit an Cloud-Projekten sowie Unterstützung der IT-Leitung bei Architektur-, Infrastruktur- und Security-Themen


Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker (Systemintegration) oder vergleichbares Studium
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Microsoft-Cloud-Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure (Microsoft-Zertifikate wie AZ-104, AZ-305 und SC-300)
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 und Entra ID
  • Gute Kenntnisse in PowerShell und Terraform
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf Niveau B2 für eine reibungslose interne und externe Kommunikation
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung
  • Teamfähigkeit
  • Strukturierte und analytische Denkweise
  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an neuen Technologien
  • Kommunikationsstärke
  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein


Warum wir?

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • 20% Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge + 30 € zusätzlicher Zuschuss nach Abschluss der Probezeit
  • Monatlich 50 € steuerfreier Sachbezug über die Pluxee-Guthabenkarte
  • Jobticket oder einen Fahrtkostenzuschuss im Wert von bis zu 63 € im Monat
  • Rabatt in unserem Onlineshop nach Abschluss der Probezeit
  • Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit Perspektive auch ohne Branchenerfahrung

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS + CDK)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at JTL-Software-GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

Working model: Hybrid 

countX is a Berlin-based SaaS company that simplifies EU VAT compliance for e-commerce businesses. Our platform automates VAT registration, reporting, and compliance processes, enabling online merchants to expand across Europe with less administrative effort and lower compliance risk.

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to own and scale our AWS infrastructure, streamline deployments, and ensure high availability and security across our systems. You’ll be working closely with engineering teams to make our software delivery process fast, reliable, and cost-efficient — all powered by AWS and the AWS CDK.

Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain, and improve AWS infrastructure using AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or similar)
  • Automate deployments, infrastructure provisioning, and operational workflows
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance using AWS-native tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray, etc.)
  • Implement logging, alerting, and observability best practices
  • Manage networking, security groups, IAM roles, and secrets securely
  • Drive cost optimization strategies in AWS
  • Collaborate with developers to improve development-to-production workflows
  • Participate in on-call rotation and incident resolution


Your profile

  • 5+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or similar role
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3, CloudFront, etc.)
  • Proven experience with AWS CDK for Infrastructure as Code
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, CodeBuild, CodePipeline, etc.)
  • Good scripting skills (TypeScript, Python, or Bash)
  • Solid knowledge of Docker and container orchestration (ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes)
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and AWS best practices
  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)

Nice to Have
  • Experience with AWS cost optimization and tagging strategies
  • Knowledge of serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge)
  • Familiarity with compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR)

title: Broker Partnerships Lead

description_html:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.

⭐ Location

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

  • You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

  • You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

  • You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.

⭐ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

  • Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

  • Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

  • Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

  • Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

  • Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

  • Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

  • Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

  • Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

  • Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

  • Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

  • Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

  • Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

  • Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

 

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Month-end close: own the end-to-end closing cycle across multiple legal entities; push pre-formatted journal entries into NetSuite, ensure completeness and accuracy, and deliver on schedule every month (target: J+5)

  • Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

  • Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

  • Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

  • Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed

⭐️ Qualifications ⭐️

Experience and technical skills

  • 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

  • Languages: full fluency in French and English

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

  • Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

  • Reliable and detail-oriented: you deliver on time, every time, and keep a clean audit trail

  • Autonomous and self-directed: you don't wait to be told what to do next; you manage your priorities, make decisions independently, and know how to take a step back to distinguish what truly matters from day-to-day noise

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

  • Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

  • Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate

For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range.

 

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

description_html:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

🩺 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes médecin du travail référent sur un portefeuille d'entreprises adhérentes, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes:

  • Coordonner les trois missions des SPSTI (suivi individuel, action en milieu de travail, prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle) sur votre périmètre d'entreprises adhérentes, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire que vous animez : IDEST, ASST, IPRP

  • Innovation et amélioration continue: test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, optimisation des protocoles, collaboration avec les équipes de développement, etc.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

  • Une délégation réelle. L'équipe pluridisciplinaire et les IDEST prennent en charge ce qui peut l'être. Vous concentrez votre temps médical là où il a le plus d'impact.

  • La téléconsultation à la demande du salarié, intégrée à votre pratique quand elle est cliniquement pertinente.

  • Des outils numériques co-construits en fonction de vos attentes. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les médecins les outils dont ils ont besoin — DMST, parcours de prévention, assistance à la rédaction de fiche d'entreprises, etc.

👤 Le profil recherché

Indispensable :

  • Doctorat en médecine + DES ou CES de médecine du travail

  • Inscription à l'Ordre

Idéalement :

  • Goût pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et la délégation

  • Curiosité pour les outils numériques et l'IA appliqués à la pratique médicale

  • Capacité à construire une relation de confiance avec salariés et adhérents

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même. Médecins en reconversion, jeunes diplômé·es, profils internationaux... n'hésitez pas à nous contacter !

💚 Ce qu'on offre

  • Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

  • Rémunération selon profil, transparente et benchmarkée

  • Plan d'intéressement

  • Temps plein ou temps partiel (à discuter)

  • RTT

  • Prise en charge du transport quotidien

  • Restaurant d'entreprise

  • Formation linguistique offerte

  • Événements d'équipe réguliers

Pour en savoir plus sur notre politique salariale, c'est ici !
