title: Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DIU MarTech Solutions GmbH
description_html:
DIU ist führender IT-Dienstleister mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Büro-Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden sowie deutschlandweit remote entwickeln und integrieren wir IT-Lösungen auf höchstem Niveau.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade, Suzuki, Deutsche Telekom oder dpv Deutscher Pressevertrieb.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und des Glaubens an die Kraft von Technologien als zentraler Baustein für den Erfolg von Unternehmen. Gestalte jetzt mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unseres Mottos: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns bei DIU findest du hier: www.diu.digital/

Aufgaben

WANTED

Wir glauben fest daran, dass gute Beziehungen der Kern für nachhaltige Erfolge sind – besonders im Mittelstand. Für den Aufbau und die operative Weiterentwicklung unserer Kundengewinnung im MarTech-Umfeld suchen wir daher einen Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d) – jemanden, der Vertrieb nicht als Zahlenspiel versteht, sondern als Beziehungsarbeit.

Wir schreiben die Position im Raum Hamburg im Hybrid-Modell mit 1-2 Tagen Office je Woche aus. Dein Team ist auf die Standorte Hamburg und Wiesbaden (und Umgebung) verteilt und arbeitet schon länger in dieser Besetzung zusammen, denn wir stellen Teams nach Fachgebiet und Interesse zusammen - nicht nach Wohnort. Um die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie zu stärken ist die Stelle sowohl in Voll- als auch Teilzeit z.B. in einer 4-Tage-Woche ausfüllbar.

DOINGS

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Kundendialog – von der Erstansprache über die technische und fachliche Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Übergabe ins Projektteam
  • Du führst Erst- und Discovery-Gespräche, in denen du gezielt nachfragst, um sowohl die technische Ausgangslage (Systeme, Datenflüsse, bestehende MarTech-Tools) als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Problem unserer Ansprechpartner:innen zu verstehen
  • Du identifizierst relevante Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung und weiteren Branchen mit komplexen Content- und Marketing-Prozessen und sprichst Entscheider:innen in Marketing, IT und Digital gezielt an
  • Du baust und pflegst ein Netzwerk aus Empfehlungen, Partnern und bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen und ergänzt es durch gezielte Direktansprache
  • Du setzt KI-gestützte Automatisierung für Zielgruppenanalyse, Lead-Qualifizierung und CRM-Pflege ein, statt Vertrieb rein manuell zu betreiben
  • Du koordinierst Termine mit Geschäftsführung und Consultants, bereitest Kundengespräche inhaltlich vor und behältst Follow-ups im Blick
  • Du entwickelst Vertriebs- und Beratungsmaterialien mit – von der Positionierung bis zur kundenspezifischen Präsentation
  • Du spielst Kundenfeedback aus Erstgesprächen direkt ins Consulting- und Projektteam, damit unsere Lösungsvorschläge von Anfang an treffsicher sind

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW

  • 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Consulting, Partner Management oder Business Development, idealerweise im MarTech-, Software- oder IT-Umfeld
  • Technisches Grundverständnis für digitale Marketing- und Content-Prozesse (Marketing Automation, Content-Management, Schnittstellen/APIs) und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen authentisch und klar zu vermitteln
  • Du hörst genau hin und kannst aus einem Gespräch sowohl das technische Problem als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Anliegen herausarbeiten – dir reicht "wir brauchen ein neues Tool" nicht als Antwort
  • Freude an ehrlicher Kommunikation, vertrauensvoller Zusammenarbeit und persönlichem Beziehungsaufbau statt reinem "Abschluss-Denken"
  • Hohe Selbstorganisation, Strukturdenken und Umsetzungskompetenz – gute Vorbereitung und verlässliche Follow-ups sind für dich selbstverständlich
  • Intrinsische Motivation und echtes Interesse, gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Zufriedenheit zu erzielen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

DIU FOR YOU

Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

  • Deinem eigenen Weiterbildungs-Budget
  • Zertifizierungen und Weiterbildungen Deiner Wahl
  • Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation
  • Einer offenen Fehler- und Gesprächskultur
  • Einbeziehung tiefer fachlicher Themen in Management-Entscheidungen

DIU SPIRIT

Wir sind nicht laut - sondern lieber unaufgeregt und verlässlich. Wir entwickeln DIU bewusst strukturiert weiter. Bei uns findest du:

  • Sehr durchmischte Altersstrukturen
  • Eine gute und geregelte Gehaltsstruktur
  • Fachabteilungen für unsere Kerntechnologien / Gleichgesinnte
  • Moderne technische Infrastruktur und Tools
  • Teilzeitmodelle unterschiedlicher Art

GET IN

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, selbst wenn dein Profil nicht exakt auf die Beschreibung passt. Bewirb dich jetzt einfach und unkompliziert über das Bewerbungsformular und unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen.

title: Senior Account Executive - Hospitals
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Tandem Health
description_html:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.


How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

description_html:
🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

💡 Your Mission: Own the training experience for users in France

As our Founding Customer Training Manager, you will be responsible for establishing and scaling the training program for our expansion into France. You'll inherit a proven methodology from the German market and adapt it for French healthcare facilities. You will motivate and engage groups of 10-15 caregivers, empowering them to embrace the technology and improve their documentation workflow.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Lead in-person training sessions for new customer deployments, training groups of healthcare providers in French-speaking regions.

  • Refine training materials and playbooks for the French market and for individual customers as needed.

  • Travel to customer sites (estimated 2-3 weeks per month, depending on deployment schedule) to deliver on-site training and support go-live activities across France.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Product, and our German training team to optimize training approach and share insights.

  • Measure and report on training effectiveness, using adoption metrics and feedback to continuously improve our approach.

  • Ensure compliance with French healthcare regulations and documentation requirements (GDPR, standards, etc.).

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years in training, onboarding, or customer enablement in B2B, ideally healthcare or another technical environment - and you have built a program from scratch, not just delivered one

  • Proven track record designing and delivering in-person training to non-technical and mixed-ability audiences

  • Business fluent level of French (C2 or bilingual) including regional and cultural nuance, plus working English for the international team

  • You use adoption metrics and feedback to sharpen your approach, and you can work around legacy EHRs and limited IT infrastructure

🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize

  • Become a co-creator of our success with virtual stock options.

  • France-based opportunity. Work from anywhere in France (travel to customer sites as needed). We have bases in Berlin and are expanding into France.

  • Flexible working hours because you know best when you work most efficiently.

  • Open culture with regular team collaboration and learning opportunities.

  • You'll work on the founding team for a high-growth function - significant opportunity for impact and rapid growth.

  • Your work will make a real impact, helping alleviate workload for healthcare professionals and improving care documentation quality.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year + French public holidays.

✨ Ready to talk?

We look forward to your application. If you're curious about how training intersects with adoption, customer success, and healthcare transformation, we'd love to meet you—no matter who you are or what background you have.

title: Finance Business Partner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Everfield
description_html:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

Benefits

Wir glauben an kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, in der jeder Beitrag zählt. Ihre Entwicklung steht bei uns im Fokus: Wir fördern Ihr Wissen und Ihre Fähigkeiten durch spezialisierte Weiterbildungen und spannende Projekte.

Wir legen großen Wert auf eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance und eine faire Vergütung. Denn wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter das wichtigste Asset des Unternehmens sind – darum bieten wir ihnen nicht nur 30 Urlaubstage sowie marktgerechte Bezahlung, sondern ebenso flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zu mobilem Arbeiten. Zusätzlich werden Mitarbeiterbenefits, wie etwa das Leasing eines Dienstrades, angeboten.

Bei proadvise werden Sie Teil eines jungen, engagierten und motivierten Teams, das gemeinsam an einem Strang zieht. Sie haben stets die Möglichkeit eigene Ideen einzubringen und durch Kreativität und Motivation den Unternehmenserfolg persönlich mitzugestalten.

Unsere Benefits in aller Kürze:

  • Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Regelmäßige Teambuilding- und Firmenevents
  • 30 Tage Urlaub

Sind Sie bereit, die Projektlandschaft großer Unternehmen mitzugestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung und darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung inkl. Gehaltsvorstellung senden Sie bitte per Bewerbungsformular z.H. Hr. Andreas Kories.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Kpler
description_html:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

  • Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

  • Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes.


    • Experience & Background
    What you'll need (Must-haves)

    • Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer.

    • Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks.

    • Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

    • Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

    • DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

    • MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

    • Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English.

      • Nice-to-haves

      • Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.

      • Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

      • Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

    We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

    We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

    Our People Pledge
     
    Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
     
    Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Head of Talent
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Carwow
description_html:
Our Mission

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we're a long way from done!

Your Mission

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Head of Talent Acquisition to own how Carwow attracts, hires and builds the teams that will get us there.

This is a leadership role at a genuine inflection point: you'll take full ownership of the talent acquisition function - from headcount planning and budget through to the quality of every hire we make - at a business that's scaling fast and changing shape as it goes.

You'll partner directly with senior stakeholders across the business to understand what they need to grow their teams, build the plans to deliver it, and hold the bar high enough that every hire raises the average performance and cultural strength of Carwow.

You'll lead and develop a high-performing talent team, own our employer brand in partnership with our Employee Experience team, and make sure DEI is built into how we hire rather than bolted on. You'll be the person who knows our hiring data - with live dashboards the business trusts - and who gets the most out of our tools (Ashby included) rather than just using them. Above all, you'll bring the rigour, creativity and pace that a fast-moving scale-up needs, and be comfortable picking up whatever the business needs next.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end workforce and capability planning - partnering with and challenging the Exec on what capability we need, when we need it, and whether hiring is always the right answer - and translate that into Carwow's talent acquisition strategy, headcount plan and budget, connected to broader workforce planning and succession.

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders to understand their talent needs and translate them into hiring plans that deliver against their goals, acting as a trusted advisor on hiring strategy and org design.

  • Lead and directly influence our most senior and business-critical searches, including Exec-level hiring, bringing the judgement and market credibility to attract top-tier talent.

  • Raise the calibre of talent we bring into Carwow - A-players on both performance and culture - backed by consistent scorecards, structured interview processes and quality-of-hire tracking, so we can prove, not just assume, that our bar is going up.

  • Build out our talent intelligence capability so we're not just reacting to open roles - mapping critical and emerging skill pools ahead of need and giving the business a genuine edge as we scale.

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing talent acquisition team - setting clear expectations, building a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, and flexing the team's capacity and structure as the business scales.

  • Own how AI shows up across sourcing, process and productivity, and use your own expertise to get ahead of how the skills and talent Carwow needs will change, evolving how we assess and hire for it accordingly.

  • Own employer brand and how Carwow shows up externally to candidates, working closely with the Employee Experience team on our proposition, story and candidate experience.

  • Implement and embed our DEI strategy within talent acquisition, ensuring inclusive hiring practices are built into every stage of the process.

  • Upskill hiring managers on how to hire the best talent - from writing better job specs to running structured, bias-aware interviews.

  • Take on projects beyond your core remit as part of the wider leadership team's priorities.

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience leading a talent acquisition function in a fast-paced, high-growth scale-up environment, ideally including significant periods of organisational change.

  • Experience building, leading and developing high-performing talent teams, with strong people management and coaching skills.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior leadership and translating business needs into talent plans.

  • A data-driven approach - comfortable building and using dashboards and metrics (e.g. time to hire, cost per hire, quality of hire) to drive decisions and report upwards.

  • Confident, expert-level knowledge of AI tools and how they apply to talent acquisition

  • Hands-on experience implementing DEI strategy within hiring, with a track record of embedding inclusive practices into recruitment processes.

  • You've owned senior, business-critical or Exec-level searches and know how to bring the credibility that level demands.

  • Experience owning employer brand and candidate experience, partnering with People/Employee Experience functions.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with evolving structures and shifting priorities, and able to balance long-term strategy with short-term delivery.

What's in it for you

  • Hybrid working (2 days working from home)

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • The option to work from abroad up to 4 weeks

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you've been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch & learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

YOUR MISSION

Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and the People Operations team is the engine that keeps their experience running smoothly. We’re looking for a support in an upcoming German project for the next 6-12 monts. As our People Operations Executive for Germany, you'll own the accurate, on-time running of our monthly German payroll and be the trusted first point of contact for our German employees' questions on pay, benefits, and everything across the employee lifecycle.

This is a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who takes real pride in getting things right, thrives in a fast-moving environment, and genuinely enjoys making colleagues feel looked after. You're fluent in German and English, bring hands-on experience of German payroll and employment regulations, and are comfortable handling administrative tasks as part of your responsibilities. You'll be the person who turns it into something reliable, organised, and even better than you found it, using AI and smart tooling to work faster and smarter.

This is a great opportunity to build your career in People Operations: you'll take ownership of the day-to-day running of German payroll and the employee lifecycle for Germany, with support and guidance from the wider People Operations team as you grow into a more senior, more autonomous role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Payroll:

  • Own the end-to-end processing of our monthly German payroll accurately and on time, from gathering inputs (new starters, leavers, changes, bonuses/commission, absence) through to submission and reconciliation.

  • Act as the point of contact for our German payroll provider, resolving queries and making sure everything ties out each cycle.

  • Ensure payroll compliance with German payroll and employment legislation (income tax, social security contributions, and other statutory requirements) and keep on top of regulatory changes.

  • Maintain meticulous payroll records and support year-end processes and statutory reporting requirements for Germany.

Employee queries & support:

  • Be the friendly, reliable first responder for questions from our German employees on payroll, benefits, and lifecycle matters, resolving them promptly and clearly in German and English so everyone feels supported.

  • Advise employees on people policies and processes, escalating the genuinely complex or sensitive with good judgement and discretion.

  • Spot recurring questions and turn them into self-serve answers, FAQs, and clearer documentation.

Benefits:

  • Administer our benefits programmes for German employees day to day, including enrolments, changes, leavers, and provider liaison.

  • Help employees understand and make the most of what's on offer.

  • Support benefits renewals and improvements, keeping records accurate throughout.

Employee lifecycle:

  • Process joiners, leavers, and employee changes within Germany, and deliver a smooth, engaging experience across the full lifecycle, including onboarding, contractual changes, family leave, and offboarding.

  • Prepare accurate documentation (contracts, letters, changes to terms) in line with German employment regulations, and keep our HRIS (Hibob) clean and up to date at all times.

  • Make sure every touchpoint feels considered, so people have a great experience from day one to their last day.

Data, systems & admin:

  • Keep our people data accurate, consistent, and audit-ready. You'll treat data quality as non-negotiable.

  • Produce clear, reliable reports and pull basic insights to support decision-making.

  • Use AI tools and automation to reduce manual effort, speed up admin, and improve accuracy.

Continuous improvement:

  • Take ownership of your processes and proactively look for ways to make them simpler, faster, and more reliable.

  • Suggest and implement improvements to workflows and documentation, leaving things better than you found them.

title: Senior IT-Projektmanager / Technical Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IT Studio Rech GmbH
description_html:
Business Systems, Digitalisierung & KI

Du verstehst Softwareentwicklung, denkst in Geschäftsprozessen und bringst komplexe Projekte in die Umsetzung? Dann unterstütze mit uns wachsende Unternehmen dabei, ihre Systeme, Daten und Abläufe zukunftsfähig aufzustellen.

Du bist arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Fachabteilungen und technischen Verantwortlichen unserer Kunden zusammen. Unser Beratungs- und Engineering-Team unterstützt dich mit fachlichem Sparring und Entwicklungskompetenz.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für Digitalisierungs- und Softwareprojekte – von der ersten Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Einführung. Dabei verbindest du technische Tiefe mit wirtschaftlichem Denken und verlässlicher Projektsteuerung.

  • Anforderungen klären: Du analysierst Prozesse, Systeme und Datenflüsse und führst die Bedürfnisse verschiedener Fachbereiche zusammen.
  • Lösungen bewerten: Du vergleichst Standardsoftware, Integrationen und Eigenentwicklung hinsichtlich Nutzen, Kosten, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit.
  • Umsetzung steuern: Du entwickelst priorisierte Roadmaps, definierst Arbeitspakete und koordinierst Beteiligte, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungen.
  • Ergebnisse sichern: Du begleitest Einführung und Abnahme, dokumentierst Wissen und bereitest die Übergabe an interne Teams vor.
  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und berücksichtigst dabei Qualität, Datenschutz und Sicherheit.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in technischer Projektleitung, IT-Beratung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit eigenständig verantworteten Software- oder Integrationsprojekten.
  • Eigene Softwareentwicklungserfahrung und fundiertes Verständnis für Datenmodelle, APIs, Architektur und nachhaltigen Softwarebetrieb.
  • Starke Analysefähigkeiten: Du übersetzt unklare Anforderungen in verständliche Prozesse, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen und umsetzbare Schritte.
  • Verständnis für Unternehmenssoftware, insbesondere für das Zusammenspiel von CRM, Backoffice, Kundenservice und Reporting.
  • Wirtschaftliches Urteilsvermögen: Du priorisierst nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiken und kannst Eigenentwicklung gegen Zukauf abwägen.
  • Selbstständigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Du beschaffst fehlende Informationen, hältst offene Themen nach und schaffst Orientierung bei wechselnden Anforderungen.
  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführung, Fachbereichen und Entwicklern sowie Praxisverständnis für KI und Automatisierung.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Erfahrungen mit wachsenden Unternehmen, CRM-/ERP-Einführungen, Unternehmensgruppen, KI-gestützter Entwicklung oder Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make und Zapier.

Benefits

Du erhältst eigenständige Projektverantwortung, direkten Austausch mit Entscheidern und fachliche Unterstützung durch unser Team. Du gestaltest technische Lösungen mit und begleitest ihre Einführung in den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden.

Entscheidend sind für uns deine nachweisbaren Projektergebnisse und dein technisches Urteilsvermögen. Einen bestimmten Abschluss, eine Zertifizierung oder einen festen Technologie-Stack setzen wir nicht voraus.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein bis zwei kurze Projektbeispiele: Welche Herausforderung hast du übernommen, welche Verantwortung hattest du und was wurde erreicht?

description_html:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. The Forward Deployed Engineer will provide technical expertise and support to customers during the implementation and use of Shield AI enterprise software products. What You'll Do
  • Become an expert user of the Hivemind Enterprise Autonomy Software Development Kit.

  • Provide technical training to customers for their autonomy development efforts.
  • Assist customers in integrating Hivemind autonomy to their vehicles/platforms.
  • Help customers debug software/API integration issues.
  • Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to address customer feedback and improve products.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and training materials Assist the sales team in answering complex technical queries from customers.
  • Travel to customer sites as required (30% travel).

description_html:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Director of Field Marketing, Europe will establish and scale Shield AI’s field marketing function across Europe, with responsibility for supporting priority market development and programs in Africa as needed.

This leader will build the strategy, operating model, processes, and team required to deepen engagement with strategic government, defense, military, and industry stakeholders; accelerate priority opportunities; and create measurable pipeline impact.

This is a player-coach role in a high-growth environment. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable setting regional strategy and executing programs in the field. They thrive in ambiguity, can build new capabilities from the ground up, and adapt quickly as Shield AI expands its international go-to-market presence.

Based in London, this role will work closely with regional Growth, Business Development, Capture, Sales, Communications, and product teams. It will require regular travel across Europe and periodic travel to Africa.


What You'll Do
  • Lead and scale field marketing across Europe, aligned closely with Shield AI’s regional Go-to-Market, Growth, Business Development, Capture, and Sales priorities.
  • Develop the regional field marketing strategy for priority European defense, government, military, and industry accounts, while supporting select opportunities and events in Africa.
  • Build and institutionalize field marketing as a disciplined, account-led, revenue-aligned function within a fast-growing global organization.
  • Develop and execute account-based marketing strategies for priority accounts, mapping buying groups and orchestrating multi-touch engagement across executive briefings, targeted events, customer programs, partner activity, and integrated campaigns.
  • Build engagement strategies tailored to key defense and government stakeholders, including senior military leaders, defense ministry officials, program leaders, acquisition teams, operational commanders, technical evaluators, and industry partners.
  • Own the strategy and execution for major European defense, aerospace, autonomy, and security events, prioritizing high-value account engagement, executive meetings, and opportunity progression over brand presence alone.
  • Establish event and program plans that align with regional procurement cycles, defense modernization priorities, budget timing, acquisition pathways, and capture strategies.
  • Partner with regional Go-to-Market teams to create and execute targeted account-based events and programs that generate new pipeline, advance existing opportunities, and deepen executive relationships.
  • Build and lead a high-performing Europe field marketing team while remaining hands-on with agencies, vendors, contracts, logistics, event production, and program delivery.
  • Create repeatable regional planning, intake, measurement, and reporting processes that enable disciplined prioritization across markets, accounts, events, and campaigns.
  • Establish KPIs that reflect complex defense sales cycles, including account penetration, stakeholder engagement depth, executive meeting quality, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, opportunity acceleration, and program return on investment.
  • Ensure programs reflect Shield AI’s brand, strategic narrative, and market position while adapting messaging and experiences appropriately for local markets and audiences.
  • Bring creativity, structure, sound judgment, and adaptability to an evolving environment where new international capabilities are being built in real time.

    • Required Qualifications
  • 12 + years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, or integrated marketing roles.
  • Demonstrated success marketing into European government, defense, military, aerospace, national security, or complex public-sector accounts.
  • Strong understanding of European defense and government buying environments, including long sales cycles, multi-year programs, procurement processes, and multi-stakeholder acquisition decisions.
  • Experience developing and executing account-based marketing strategies within complex enterprise, government, or defense accounts.
  • Credibility engaging senior military leaders, government officials, defense program leaders, acquisition stakeholders, and executive-level industry partners.
  • Proven experience leading teams while also operating as a hands-on builder and operator.
  • Experience planning and delivering high-impact executive engagement programs, strategic customer events, trade shows, and integrated field campaigns.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Growth, Communications, Product, and regional leadership teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively across multiple European markets, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Europe and periodically to Africa.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional European languages are a plus.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift and structure is still being developed.

About Legend
 

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.


The role:
 
Legend are hiring a Product Manager to join the gaming division - and in particular to work on our Flagship iGaming site.
 
The role demands a key eye for commercial competitiveness, thorough research on competitors, and the ability to spearhead innovation within an ever-evolving industry. Driving the delivery of active initiatives while maintaining and enhancing a crucial part of the our flagship websites function is essential to long-term success.
 
You'll be working alongside phenomenal, industry-leading experts who share your drive for quality, business acumen, and passion to push boundaries. Together, we'll research competitors, identify gaps, and build cutting-edge solutions that engage new audiences, re-engage loyal customers, and deliver premium leads to our affiliate partners.
 
Here, no idea is too bold—we encourage blue-sky thinking to truly move the needle and set the industry standard for product excellence, process innovation, and commercial competitiveness.
If you're ready to make an immediate impact, drive meaningful change, and shape the future of the online gaming space, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for.
 
 

Why Legend?
  • Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
  • Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
  • Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
  • Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
  • Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.

Work closely with cross-functional teams (engineering, design) to deliver quality product updates on time and frequently.

description_html:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

STARK's maritime division is at the forefront of autonomous surface and subsea innovation. title: Senior Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Userlane
description_html:
About Userlane

Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally.

Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.


Your mission

Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as:

  • Defining metrics that hold up: Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete.

  • Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on

  • Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"

  • Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems,

  • Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once

  • AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation

  • You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

  • You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"

  • You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does.

  • You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight

  • You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus

  • You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product

  • You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike

  • You're fluent in English (spoken and written)


What's in for you

  • Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries

  • Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems

  • Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors

  • Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry

  • Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training
    Benefits: We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

Paid Media Manager 

Remote / Hybrid 

 

Drive Growth Through Data-Driven Paid Media

 

We're looking for an ambitious and commercially focused Paid Media Manager to join our Group Acquisition Team and play a key role in driving customer acquisition and engagement across multiple international markets. 

 

This is an exciting opportunity for a paid media specialist who thrives on combining strategic thinking with hands-on campaign management. You'll take ownership of paid search activity across a portfolio of markets while exploring opportunities across emerging channels including paid social, programmatic advertising, and AI-driven marketing solutions.  

 

 

What You'll Be Doing 

 *Develop, execute, optimise and report on paid media campaigns across multiple markets.

*Own paid search strategy and performance for your markets, driving sustainable customer acquisition and commercial growth. 

*Collaborate with local marketing teams to align channel strategies with market growth objectives. 

*Analyse campaign and business performance, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations. 

*Lead campaign measurement, tracking and reporting, ensuring stakeholders have visibility of performance and opportunities. 

Drive continuous optimisation through audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget management and testing. 

*Design and evaluate testing programmes, including incrementality testing, in partnership with data teams. 

*Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, agencies and platform partners. 

*Leverage automation, AI tools and scalable processes to improve campaign effectiveness and operational efficiency. 

*Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging opportunities within the paid media landscape. 

 

 

What We're Looking For 

 

*Proven experience as a Paid Media Manager, PPC Manager or similar role in-house or agency-side. 

*Deep expertise in Google Ads and strong SEM/PPC knowledge. 

*Experience managing large, complex accounts and delivering against commercial growth targets. 

*Strong analytical skills and confidence using tools such as Google Analytics 4 and Excel. 

*Experience utilising automation, scripts, AI tools or AI agents to improve campaign performance and efficiency. 

*Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 

*Strong project management and organisational abilities. 

*A commercial mindset with a collaborative approach and attention to detail. 

 

Bonus Points If You Have 

*Experience with Meta Ads or other paid media channels beyond search.

*Background in veterinary, healthcare, pet care or other service-led sectors.

You'll be joining a high-performing acquisition team where innovation, experimentation and data-driven decision making are central to success. If you're passionate about performance marketing, thrive on delivering results, and want to be part of a team that's constantly pushing the boundaries of digital acquisition, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Working Student HR & People Operations (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Omegga
description_html:
Our Mission

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive in-ovo sex detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Mission

You'll work directly with our Head of Finance&HR and keep the people side of Omegga running while we scale. This is not a "help out where needed" working student role. You own recurring processes end to end, and you get real responsibility from week one.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the operational employee lifecycle. Prepare contracts and documents, coordinate equipment and accounts, run structured first days, and manage clean offboardings.

  • Personio: Keep our HR system the single source of truth. Maintain employee data, absences, digital personnel files, and documentation quality, and help us get more out of the tool than we do today.

  • Recruiting Support: Draft and publish job ads, keep our applicant tracking system clean, coordinate interview scheduling, and own candidate communication so no application goes unanswered.

  • Recruiting Day: Organize our candidate day end to end: invitations, agenda, materials, interviewer briefings, and on site coordination.

  • Internal Events: Plan and run internal formats, from team events to company offsite

  • Development Budget: Take ownership of our people development budget. Build the process and guideline from scratch with us, then run it: track requests and spend, support colleagues in finding the right trainings, and keep it transparent.

  • Performance & Review Process: Help us prepare the rollout of our company wide review cycle. You build templates, timelines and tooling, and drive the internal communication around it.

Your Profile

  • Enrolled student (Bachelor or Master), around 16 hours per week during the semester, more during breaks if you want to. We plan in weeks, not fixed days, so exams and lectures can be accommodated as long as recurring processes stay covered. Ideally for at least 12 months. Your field of study is open. Business, psychology, law or something entirely different. What matters is that you care how people work in a company, not which lecture hall you sit in.

  • Some practical experience in HR, recruiting or operations, ideally somewhere that moved fast. We don't need an HR certificate. We need structure and judgment.

  • You catch what others miss. The missing signature, the wrong start date, the empty field in Personio. In HR, sloppy data becomes someone's problem three months later.

  • Discretion is second nature. You handle contract and personnel data without ever making it a topic.

  • You'd rather fix a process than repeat it. New tools don't scare you (Personio, Ashby, Notion, Google Workspace), and manual work twice in a row makes you build something better. You close loops without being asked. You structure your own week, decide when a decision is needed, and you push back when someone tries to bend a process.


Not ticking every box? That's okay. One exception to the above: German at C1 level or above is required for this role.
If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

Why Us

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Real Ownership: You won't be doing research tasks on the side. You run processes that the whole company touches, and you'll see the results of your work in how the whole team experiences Omegga.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Most of our work happens in the office, remote work is possible depending on the task.

description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform—while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to support advertisers in onboarding, launching, and growing on OpenAI’s advertising platform. You will manage a portfolio of partners and serve as a trusted advisor, helping them achieve their business objectives while ensuring a strong and responsible experience on our platform.

This role sits at the intersection of relationship management, strategy, and execution. You’ll work closely with Sales to drive long-term partner growth and with internal teams to continuously improve the advertiser experience.

This role is based in our Munich office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own relationships with a portfolio of advertising partners, serving as their primary point of contact.

  • Guide advertisers through onboarding and campaign launches to ensure strong adoption of OpenAI’s ads products.

  • Analyze campaign performance and provide clear, actionable recommendations to improve outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through increased product adoption and incremental investment.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Analytics, Policy, and Operations to resolve issues and enhance platform value.

  • Surface advertiser feedback and insights to inform product improvements and long-term strategy.

  • Help build scalable processes and best practices that support the growth of OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5-10+ years of experience in digital advertising, account management, customer success, consulting or a related client-facing role.

  • Have experience managing advertiser or agency relationships in a platform, publisher, or adtech environment.

  • Are comfortable interpreting performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.

  • Have experience with data querying (e.g. SQL, advanced excel/GSheet)

  • Communicate clearly and build trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Operate with ownership and accountability in fast-moving, evolving environments.

  • Demonstrate sound judgment and a commitment to user trust and responsible platform growth.

About OpenAI

title: Enterprise Customer Success Team Lead DACH

description_html:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is predicted to cost the world $10.5 trillion annually by 2025 - we invite you to be part of the solution!

Your mission:
Are you a people-person who thrives on helping others grow and succeed? Do you enjoy coaching, sharing your knowledge, and setting your peers up for success? This newly created role offers the opportunity to build our first Enterprise focused Customer Success team for DACH. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Customer Success, you’ll drive team performance through coaching, development, and clear accountability, while ensuring alignment with segment, regional and global strategy. You’ll play a key role in building a strong CSM culture, enabling your team to deliver measurable impact for our largest customers. All of this while contributing to one of the most exciting industries in digitalisation — helping to make the internet a little bit safer, together with a highly driven team.

Here's how you'll make a difference:
• Lead, guide, and support a team of Enterprise Customer Success Managers, driving performance against key metrics (gross retention, net revenue retention, and expansion) across a portfolio of high-value, strategic accounts
• Build and own the enterprise account strategy including risk management, expansion planning, and executive sponsorship programs for your team's book of business
• Coach your team on navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying and renewal environments, including negotiation strategy and commercial structuring for high-ARR contracts
• Personally engage with C-level and senior stakeholders on strategic accounts to build executive relationships, resolve escalations, and reinforce long-term partnership value
• Clearly communicate company vision, strategy, and goals within your team, translating them into account-level execution
• Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Partner leadership to ensure a cohesive enterprise/regional go-to-market strategy
• Spot knowledge gaps and training needs, setting your team up for success while identifying process and tooling improvements to scale enterprise-grade delivery
• Analyze account health data and portfolio trends to shape targeted strategies, risk mitigation plans, and expansion initiatives across the Enterprise segment
• Represent the voice of the enterprise customer internally, ensuring insights from strategic accounts inform product, process, and go-to-market decisions
• Cultivate advocacy at the executive level references, case studies, and speaking opportunities turning strategic accounts into brand champions

What makes you a great fit:
• 10+ years Customer Success experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, with meaningful time managing enterprise or strategic accounts
• 3+ years leading Enterprise Customer Success teams, ideally with exposure to complex or multi-stakeholder account portfolios
• Demonstrated ability to build relationships with and influence senior/C-level stakeholders, both externally and internally
• Commercial acumen, comfortable with quantifying ROI/value for large accounts
• Strong track record of retention and expansion within complex, multi-threaded accounts
• Naturally curious, skilled at uncovering stakeholders' goals, politics, and buying dynamics beyond the obvious
• Resilience and grit, able to stay effective and solution-oriented navigating escalations, ambiguity, and high-stakes conversations
• Confident communicator and presenter, capable of holding a room with senior internal and external stakeholders
• Empathetic and people-oriented, able to build trust-based relationships internally and externally while motivating and inspiring others
• Happy to travel ~30% of the time for customer onsites and industry events
• Fluent in English and German
• Based in Cologne or Berlin within a reasonable commute to our office

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and Financial support: Open Up, Corporate Discounts

  • Coming together for moments that matter: annual company off-site, team events, local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Learning & Development Allowance, Tech Equipment, Referral Bonuses, Dog Friendly HQ



*Perks and Benefits listed above are for full-time employees and can vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample; you’ll learn about more benefits offered during the interview process

About Us
At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.
Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.
If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

  • Strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, auch in stressigen Situationen behältst du den Überblick.

  • Teamfähigkeit und Lust mit Automatisierungen und KI-gestützten Workflows zu arbeiten.

  • Begeisterung, gemeinsam mit unserem Team zu wachsen.

  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Möglichst zeitnaher Start bei uns.

  • Die Möglichkeit in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodel zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten*:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

  • Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club

  • Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

*Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.

Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.

Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

title: Corporate (Mid-Market) Account Executive DACH (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at SoSafe
description_html:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

Als Corporate Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude!

Gemeinsam mit dem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team baust du täglich dein Kundennetzwerk aus und übertriffst deine Ziele. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und weißt, wie du unser Cybersecurity-Angebot positionierst und eine Lösung präsentierst, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können!

Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Pre-Sales, Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neue Geschäftsfelder voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle.

So trägst du zum Erfolg bei:

  • Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Corporate (Mid-Market)-Segment.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten

    Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und

    deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur

    Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline.

  • Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in

    enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern.

  • Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller

    Kunden, um den Mehrwert der SoSafe-Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend zu

    präsentieren.

  • Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation

    unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts.

Was dich auszeichnet:

  • 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus

    auf SMB- oder Mid-Market-Kunden.

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst die Initiative, behältst

    Ziele im Blick und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss.

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross-

    funktionalen Teams.

  • Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten.

  • Anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld

    flexibel zu managen.

  • Offen für Feedback und Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen und dich

    weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im hybriden Modell – mit Anwesenheitstagen im Büro

    sowie Remote-Tagen.

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und

    LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Standort: Köln/ deutschlandweit (Remote) - bei uns arbeitest du hauptsächlich remote und kommst für regelmäßige Teamtage nach Köln (z. B. monatlich).

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

title: Medical Translators - German into Estonian - Remote
