description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


➡️ Mission

Join us as a Customer Care Manager to help French solo entrepreneurs get the most out of Qonto's brand-new accounting offer. You'll own their day-to-day questions in Zendesk , working under the guidance of Janita, Lead Customer Service, on a scope you'll help shape from day one.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own the ticket queue: Answer French solo entrepreneurs' questions by email and chat, and hop on the phone when a topic calls for it.
  • Bridge with our accountants: Take over client requests handed off by our accountants so they can focus on the accounting itself.
  • Build the playbook from scratch: Create FAQs, macros, and better ways of working, since this scope is brand new.
  • Feed insights back to Product: Flag recurring issues so the team fixes the root cause, not just the ticket.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • You learn fast: You've picked up complex, technical topics on your own before — no accounting background needed, just the appetite to learn it.
  • You're fluent in French: Native or near-native fluency, both written and spoken.
  • You're organized under pressure: You juggle email, chat, and calls without letting anything slip.
  • You're customer-obsessed: You naturally put yourself in the client's shoes before answering.
  • You're AI-curious: You don't need to be an AI power user yet, but you're open to using it in your day-to-day.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A ground-floor seat on a brand-new, high-visibility initiative.
  • Real ownership over process: you'll help build the FAQs, macros, and workflows for this scope, not just follow them.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Janita Käyhkö, Customer Care Lead at Qonto. She grew from CSM into a multi-team leader across Lyyti, Regate, and now Qonto (following Regate's acquisition). She's built processes from scratch and knows how to dig into complex client problems. She’s an empathetic manager who gives her team the context and autonomy to own their projects, and expects them to bring solutions.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

title: Strategic Partner Account Manager DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aircall
description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

  • Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

  • Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

    • Partner Relationship Management:

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

    • Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement:

  • Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

  • Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

  • Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

  • Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

    • Forecasting & Reporting:

  • Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections.

  • Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

    • Program Development & Optimization:

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management


    • Qualifications:
  • Confident Communicator. Languages: Native German language, English fluent. 

  • You have at least 2-3 years of experience, ideally in partnership development, in a competitive, data-driven environment. 

  • You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and an interest in technology

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.

  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.

  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.

description_html:
Du studierst Marketing, Business oder einen verwandten Studiengang und willst endlich richtig loslegen? Du interessierst dich für Content Marketing, SEO und digitale Strategien und möchtest lernen, wie moderne Webseiten und Landingpages wirklich performen?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen Studierende mit Drive, die nicht nur zuschauen, sondern aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Bei uns bekommst du die Chance, die digitale Marketingstrategie im Healthcare-Umfeld hands-on mitzugestalten – von der Keyword-Recherche bis zur strategischen Konzeption von Landingpages.

Unser Ziel: Wir wollen dich langfristig entwickeln und bieten dir die Möglichkeit, auch nach deinem Studium mit uns Karriere zu machen.

Aufgaben

  • Content Marketing & Landingpages: Du unterstützt bei der strategischen und operativen Erstellung von Landingpages und entwickelst neuen Content für unsere Website.
  • SEO & Keyword-Recherche: Du recherchierst relevante Keywords, analysierst Suchintentionen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Content-Strategie.
  • Strategische Webseitenentwicklung: Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website mit und denkst aktiv darüber nach, wie Inhalte, Texte, Bilder und Seitenelemente optimal aufgebaut werden.
  • Operative Umsetzung der Strategien: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die operative Umsetzung unserer Marketing- und Content-Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass Konzepte effizient und qualitativ hochwertig umgesetzt werden.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Developer-Team: Du begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Konzepte gemeinsam mit unserem internen Entwicklerteam und stimmst dich regelmäßig mit verschiedenen Teams ab.
  • Analyse & Optimierung: Du unterstützt dabei, Inhalte und Seiten kontinuierlich zu optimieren und datenbasierte Verbesserungen abzuleiten

Qualifikation

  • Laufendes Studium: Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Business oder einen verwandten Studiengang.
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung: Du hast bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Content Marketing, SEO, SEA oder digitalen Marketingmaßnahmen gesammelt – egal ob im Praktikum, Studium, Nebenjob oder privaten Projekten.
  • Interesse an strategischem Marketing: Du willst verstehen, wie erfolgreiche Webseiten, Landingpages und Content-Strategien aufgebaut werden.
  • Hands-On Mentalität: Du arbeitest pragmatisch, probierst Dinge aus und setzt Ideen schnell um.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du bist motiviert, dich schnell weiterzuentwickeln und neue Themen eigenständig zu lernen.
  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, holst dir aktiv Feedback und bringst eigene Ideen ein.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du kannst mindestens 15–20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten und hast Lust, bei uns richtig durchzustarten

Benefits

  • Schneller Einstieg in die Praxis: Keine halben Sachen – bei uns startest du von Tag 1 mit echten Projekten und übernimmst Verantwortung für Kampagnen.
  • Intensive Begleitung: Du bekommst ein erfahrenes Team an die Seite, das dich einarbeitet, unterstützt und dir ehrliches Feedback gibt.
  • Klare Perspektive: Diese Werkstudentenstelle ist dein Sprungbrett – wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, bei uns einzusteigen.
  • Drive wird belohnt: Wer Initiative zeigt, Verantwortung übernimmt und mit Engagement dabei ist, wächst bei uns schnell über sich hinaus.
  • Erfolg im Team & gelebte Teamkultur: Die besten Ideen zählen, unabhängig von deiner Position. Wir schätzen ambitionierte Persönlichkeiten und setzen auf interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir passen uns deinem Studium an – mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

Du bist dir nicht 100 % sicher, ob dein Profil passt? Kein Problem – überzeug uns mit deinem Drive, deiner Lernbereitschaft und deiner Neugier!

title: Konstrukteur / Produktentwickler (m/w/d) für Prüfadapter & Testvorrichtungen - CAD / 3D-Druck
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at eloprint
description_html:
ELOPRINT ist ein 2018 gegründetes Technologie-Startup aus Esslingen. Wir entwickeln und fertigen kundenspezifische Prüfadapter und Testvorrichtungen für Leiterplatten und elektronische Baugruppen - vom ersten CAD-Modell bis zur fertigen Vorrichtung.

Dabei arbeiten wir mit FDM-, DLP-, SLS- und MJP-3D-Druck sowie CNC-Fräsen. Da fast jedes unserer Produkte eine Sonderanfertigung ist, erwarten dich ständig neue technische Herausforderungen statt Serienkonstruktion.

Bei uns betreust du deine Projekte weitgehend eigenständig von der Kundenanforderung bis zum fertigen Produkt und kannst Prozesse, Konstruktionen und unser Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten.

Wichtig: Aufgrund des hohen praktischen Anteils in Entwicklung und Fertigung ist die Stelle vor Ort in Esslingen vorgesehen.

Aufgaben

Du betreust deine Projekte von der Idee bis zur fertigen Testvorrichtung:

  • Technische Abstimmung mit Kunden und Ausarbeitung passender Lösungen
  • Kalkulation und Erstellung von Angeboten
  • CAD-Konstruktion kundenspezifischer Prüfadapter und Testvorrichtungen
  • Auswahl geeigneter Fertigungsverfahren und Komponenten
  • 3D-Druck, Montage und Verdrahtung der Vorrichtungen
  • Inbetriebnahme, Prüfung und Optimierung deiner Konstruktionen
  • Mitarbeit an internen Projekten und Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Spaß daran, technische Probleme praktisch zu lösen und Dinge selbst zu bauen
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit CAD-Systemen - idealerweise Autodesk Fusion
  • Erfahrung mit 3D-Druck und additiver Fertigung ist von Vorteil
  • Elektronikkenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Montage/Verdrahtung sind ein Plus
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung
  • Du findest pragmatische Lösungen und hast Lust, eigene Ideen einzubringen
  • Dein Abschluss ist für uns zweitrangig - entscheidend ist, was du kannst

Benefits

Als kleines Technologieunternehmen können wir dir viel Flexibilität und Freiraum bieten:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und frei vereinbarter Wochenumfang
  • Teilzeit oder Vollzeit möglich
  • Unkomplizierte und kurzfristige Urlaubsplanung
  • Digitales Stundenkonto mit transparenter Zeiterfassung
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Direkter Einfluss auf Produkte, Prozesse und Arbeitsweise
  • Moderne 3D-Druck-, CNC- und Fertigungstechnik
  • Private Nutzung ausgewählter Maschinen nach Absprache

Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder ein paar Informationen zu deinem bisherigen Werdegang sowie deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen gewünschten Wochenumfang per E-Mail.

Du hast eigene CAD-, Elektronik- oder 3D-Druck-Projekte umgesetzt? Dann zeig sie uns gerne! Auch private Tüftelprojekte interessieren uns.

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) PLM & Technische Dokumentation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Impecto-Consulting GmbH
description_html:
Industrie | PLM, ALM, Technische Dokumentation, SAP

Du hast Einführungsprojekte im Konzernumfeld geleitet und weißt, wie man Fachbereiche, IT und Anbieter auf ein gemeinsames Ziel ausrichtet und Entscheidungen durch die Gremien bringt. Genau diese Erfahrung suchen wir.

Impecto Consulting ist eine Beratung aus Düsseldorf für Industrieunternehmen mit gewachsenen Prozess- und Systemlandschaften. Unser Thema ist Produktinformation von der Anforderung bis zum Service: die Prozesse und Systeme, die Informationen aus Entwicklung und Konstruktion durchgängig bis in Dokumentation und Service tragen – PLM, ALM, ERP, Redaktionssysteme, Verwaltungsschale. Wir bereiten Vorhaben so auf, dass sie entschieden werden können, und steuern anschließend die Umsetzung. Die Einführung der Systeme übernehmen die Anbieter; wir arbeiten herstellerneutral. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

Du leitest bei unseren Kunden die Umsetzung von Vorhaben rund um Produktinformation und die Systeme, in denen sie entsteht und genutzt wird – bei Konzernen ebenso wie im Mittelstand. Du begleitest die Fachbereiche durch Anforderungsaufnahme, Test und Migration und stimmst die Projektarbeit mit ihrem Tagesgeschäft ab. Du steuerst die Anbieter auf Ebene der Lieferobjekte, bereitest Gremienentscheidungen vor und stellst sie gemeinsam mit dem Kunden vor. Für den Kunden bist du der Ansprechpartner für Planung, Fortschritt und Steuerung des Projekts. Die fachliche Lösung – Konzept, Datenarchitektur, Semantik – gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Senior Consultants.

Zwei Schwerpunkte prägen unsere Projekte derzeit. description_html:
At Solve Intelligence, we're building something people actually want - and we have the revenue and traction to prove it.

🏗️ The Role: Financial Operations Lead

Less than 24 months since launch, we are adding 7 figures of ARR per month, we have raised ~$60M USD, and we are quadrupling headcount this year. We've built a world-class team of AI PhDs, engineers, and patent attorneys. Now, we need a high-energy, ambitious Financial Operations Lead to help us scale to $1B+ ARR.

You'll be our first dedicated finance hire, based in London and working directly with the founders.

Until now, finance has not been run by any single person. Your job is to own it end-to-end: get the fundamentals running flawlessly, then build the processes, tooling, and budgets that scale us to 100+ people across our three offices (London, New York, and Munich) and our continued revenue growth.

This isn't a CFO-strategist role, and it isn't bookkeeping.

It's for a hands-on generalist who understands accounting deeply, executes relentlessly, and is happy to go invoice-by-invoice in the morning, build the company budget in the afternoon, and model financials in the evening. You'll do things that don't scale at first to learn the business inside out, automate them away with tooling and AI, and grow into a true business partner to Sales and Marketing — the person with a 360° view of Solve.

What you'll own:

  • Payments (AP): Own supplier payments end-to-end — approval workflows, invoices paid on time, duplicates and double-payments caught before they happen — and lead vendor negotiations on everything from software to office space.

  • Billing & Collections (AR): Own customer invoicing across our 1,000+ law firm and enterprise clients. Partner with RevOps to collect our backlog of overdue invoices fast and keep cash flowing in.

  • The Monthly Close & Metrics: Run our external accountants to an accurate, on-time close every month. Own our financial metrics — definitions, reporting, the single source of truth — and work hand-in-hand with the CEO on communicating them to the board and investors.

  • Processes & Tooling: Design and implement our finance stack from scratch. Approvals, procurement, spend management, billing, and more. Choose tools that scale and automate aggressively with AI.

  • Budgets & Financial Culture: Work directly with the founders to build our first budgeting and approval processes (hiring, marketing, conferences, offices, etc) and partner closely with every team. Help the founders instil a culture where money is not free.

  • Modelling & Big Decisions: Build the financial models behind our biggest calls — office leases, hiring plans, marketing budgets — and get stuck into special projects like M&A (we've already made two acquisitions this year).

  • International Finance: Own the finance side of operating and expanding across three countries (and counting): budgets for new office setup, transfer pricing, and international tax, working with our external advisors.

  • Cash & Treasury: Steward the ~$60M we've raised: payroll and vendors always paid, cash put to work safely.

💡 About Solve Intelligence

We are the fastest-growing startup transforming Intellectual Property. Our AI platform handles everything from invention harvesting and patent generation through to litigation and licensing.

  • Growth: 20–30% MoM revenue growth; 8 figures of ARR just ~2 years since launch.

  • Market: 600+ IP teams across 6 continents, including Tier-1 firms like DLA Piper, tech giants, and boutiques.

  • Impact: Users report 50–90% efficiency and quality improvements.

  • Backing: ~$60M from Y Combinator, 20VC, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and the founders of top companies like Stripe, Perplexity, Tinder, Deel, Hugging Face, and Canva. See our Series B announcement.

👋 Who You'll Work With

You'll be joining a founding team with deep pedigree:

  • Sanj (CRO): PhD in AI (Gatsby Unit, UCL), ex-Huawei R&D, former lead at Magic Carpet AI (acquired).

  • Chris (CEO): PhD in AI (UCL), published researcher, ex-Dyson and Alan Turing Institute.

  • Angus (CTO): MEng Computer Science, ex-Qualcomm and Coremont (Brevan Howard).

🚀 Who You Are

We are a high-performance culture. To thrive here:

  • You get your hands dirty: You'll happily go line-by-line through invoices, the CRM, and the bank to make things clean — then automate the process so it stays clean.

  • You're detail-obsessed: Duplicate invoices, overdue payments, wrong pricing — nothing gets past you.

  • You have high agency: There's no playbook and no finance team behind you (yet). Give you an ambiguous problem and you'll work it out: find the mess, own it, fix it.

  • You're a business partner, not a back-office cop: You work close to Sales, Marketing, and the wider team, helping everyone spend smarter and move faster. You know the highest-leverage thing finance can do here is accelerate growth — nudging our treasury yield from 2.7% to 2.9% is not the job.

  • You're all-in: Solve is fast and intense, and this isn't a 9–5. You get passionate — even obsessive — about the problems you own.

  • You're ambitious: You'll do the dirty work now because you want to build the finance function as we scale.

🛠️ What You Bring

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years in finance or finance-heavy operations at high-growth tech companies — e.g., FP&A lead/head, finance ops, or a generalist operator with a finance spike — now hungry for broader scope.

  • Deep fluency in accounting — you can run external accountants to an on-time close — without needing to be an accountant yourself.

  • A track record of implementing finance processes, tooling, and automation that scale with a fast-growing company.

  • Strong modelling skills across budgets, forecasts, P&L, and cash.

  • Exceptionally clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred & Nice-to-Haves:

  • First/early finance hire experience: You've built a finance function from scratch — or been the #2 to a great CFO/VP of Finance at a scaling startup and seen what good looks like.

  • Procurement & negotiation: Experience negotiating vendor contracts and pricing.

  • Treasury: Experience managing cash and liquidity at scale.

  • Multi-entity experience: Exposure to international operations — consolidation across entities, transfer pricing, or international tax.

  • Accounting foundation: An accounting qualification (ACA/ACCA/CIMA), or fundamentals from banking, consulting, or VC — since battle-tested in a scrappy, hands-on environment.

  • STEM background: A technical or quantitative degree (maths, CS, physics, engineering, etc.) — bonus points if you can write a bit of code.

  • Tooling mastery: Experience with modern finance stacks (e.g., ERP/accounting, spend management, billing & AR systems), and experience leveraging AI across everything you do (Claude Code/Cowork, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc).

🎁 What's In It For You?

  • Compensation: Competitive base + significant equity — true ownership in a high-growth startup.

  • Founding Impact: Be finance hire #1, build the function from the ground up with the freedom to spot and prioritise what matters most, and grow into leading it as we scale.

  • Support: Full visa sponsorship and private medical insurance.

  • Perks: Free meals and the chance to work with the smartest minds in AI.

Ready to own the financial engine behind the rocket ship? Apply now. 🚀

title: Senior Product Manager: Recall

description_html:
About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a highly technical, systems-minded Senior Product Manager to lead two critical search intelligence teams: Machine Learning & Recall and Query. Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval.

In this role, you will bridge the Query team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the Machine Learning & Recall team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs). You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state-of-the-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM-assisted query interpretation, with low-latency production execution. You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit.

What You’ll Do

  • Set a unified roadmap: Define the multi-quarter vision and strategy across both the Machine Learning & Recall and Query teams, ensuring query understanding and candidate generation evolve hand-in-hand.

  • Drive Query intelligence: Lead the Query team to push boundaries in tokenization, spell correction, entity extraction, intent classification, and LLM-assisted query parsing across multiple languages.

  • Advance Recall systems: Lead the Machine Learning & Recall team in evolving candidate generation architecture, seamlessly combining traditional keyword search with modern dense embeddings, vector retrieval, and hybrid recall models.

  • Move core business metrics: Own measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV across all retail customer verticals.

  • Turn research into production wins: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with ML researchers, data scientists, and software engineers to take SOTA models from research to low-latency, cost-effective production systems.

  • Balance ML performance trade-offs: Make data-backed decisions balancing model complexity, accuracy, inference latency, compute costs, and real-time execution constraints.

  • Build evaluation frameworks: Establish robust offline and online measurement systems to evaluate retrieval precision and query understanding accuracy against customer revenue outcomes.

  • Orchestrate pipeline handoffs: Ensure candidate product sets and query context flow cleanly into downstream ranking and search quality models without signal loss.

  • Solve systemic issues: Lead technical triage when query interpretation or retrieval anomalies occur, building durable, automated fixes rather than one-off patches.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Evolved our hybrid recall framework to measurably improve candidate generation precision for long-tail queries and complex catalog structures.

  • Driven quantifiable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit across major customer verticals.

  • Stood up an integrated evaluation framework connecting query parsing and candidate recall directly to business outcomes.

  • Optimized inference latency and compute infrastructure to ensure high-capacity ML models run fast and cost-effectively in production.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

ER leadership and casework

Legal work is being reshaped by AI faster than most firms can measure. Our AI Transformation & Applied Behavioural Research function exists to close that gap: we study how lawyers and legal teams actually adopt, trust, and build skill with AI, and we turn that evidence into changes across our product, customer enablement, and go-to-market motion.

As an Applied Behavioural Researcher on the team, you will bring rigor to how we measure adoption and capability growth, not just usage. You'll design the studies, build the instruments, and work the data yourself, then translate what you find into recommendations that product, customer success, and leadership can act on. This is a hands-on, mid-level role for someone who wants to do the analysis personally rather than only oversee it, while still being trusted to shape what we study next.

You'll sit close to real legal teams and real deployments, so the questions you're answering are grounded in what's actually happening in firms today, not hypothetical adoption curves.

Responsibilities

  • Design and run mixed-methods studies on how lawyers and legal professionals build real proficiency with AI tools, distinguishing genuine capability growth from surface-level usage.

  • Build and validate the surveys, interview protocols, and quantitative measures the team relies on, so findings hold up to scrutiny from product, customer, and executive stakeholders.

  • Analyze usage and outcome data directly, using standard research tooling, to surface patterns in how adoption succeeds or stalls across different firms and practice areas.

  • Translate research findings into concrete recommendations for product features, onboarding, and customer enablement programs, working closely with product managers, customer success, and engineering.

  • Communicate findings clearly through written reports, presentations, and dashboards that inform decisions made by the Director and wider leadership.

  • Help prioritize what to study next, balancing depth on a few high-value questions against breadth across a fast-moving customer base.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • A research background in applied social science, human-computer interaction, organizational psychology, or a closely related quantitative/qualitative methods discipline.

  • Solid mixed-methods skills: survey design, basic psychometrics, structured interviewing, and the judgment to pick the right method for the question at hand.

  • Hands-on technical ability in Python and data analysis, comfortable enough to run your own analyses without needing to hand off to a data team.

  • Experience running applied research inside a large, complex organization, or a similar enterprise technology environment.

  • Comfort working with messy, real-world adoption data from customers rather than clean experimental datasets.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a track record of getting research findings actually used by product and business stakeholders.

  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing professional work, and specifically legal work.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience designing or running experimentation frameworks (A/B testing) in a product or enterprise software context.

  • Prior exposure to legal, professional services, or other expertise-driven industries where trust and correctness matter as much as speed.

  • Experience partnering directly with customers to understand adoption barriers, rather than working from second-hand data alone.

  • Published or internal writing on skill development, technology adoption, or human-AI collaboration.

About Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the AI platform for in-house legal teams. Our customers use Wordsmith to move faster, automate the repetitive parts of legal work, and give their whole business quicker access to legal support. We're growing quickly, and every new customer we win deserves a brilliant experience from day one — that's where you come in.

About the role

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to be the hands-on, day-to-day champion for our customers. This is not a quota-carrying role. Your job is to make customers successful: get them onboarded quickly, answer their questions, keep our shared inbox humming, and continually drive adoption of the product across their teams.

It's an early-career role with real responsibility from week one. You'll work directly with customers every day and see the direct connection between the work you do and the value they get — and, in turn, the revenue they retain and grow with us.

What you'll do

  • Onboard new customers and new business — run the enablement process that takes a freshly signed customer from kick-off to confident, active use of Wordsmith.

  • Answer customer support questions — be the first, friendly, fast response when customers need help, and see every question through to resolution.

  • Manage the shared customer inbox — own it end to end: triage, respond, route, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.

  • Drive product adoption, constantly — spot dormant users and under-used features, run training sessions, share best practice, and turn every account into an engaged, healthy one.

  • Be the voice of the customer — feed what you hear back to the product and commercial teams so we build and sell the right things.

What we're looking for

  • 0–2 years of experience — in customer success, support, account management, hospitality, or any role where you looked after people. Recent graduates welcome.

  • Super hands-on with customers — you roll up your sleeves, get on the call, write the doc, chase the answer. You'd rather fix it than file it.

  • Commercially minded — you don't carry a quota (retention), but you understand why adoption matters: engaged customers renew, grow, and become advocates. You connect your daily work to that outcome.

  • A clear, warm communicator — comfortable writing and speaking with customers all day, and able to make technical things feel simple.

  • Organised and reliable — you can juggle an inbox, a training schedule, and a list of follow-ups without dropping any of them.

  • Curious about AI and legal tech — you don't need a legal background, but you're excited to learn the product deeply and become a genuine expert in it.

Why Wordsmith

  • Ground-floor seat at a fast-growing AI company, with a front-row view of how modern legal teams adopt AI.

  • A role where you learn the full customer lifecycle — onboarding, support, adoption, renewal — the foundation for a career in customer success or commercial roles.

  • Direct access to customers and to the founding team; your feedback shapes the product.

  • A team that ships fast, cares about customers, and will invest in your growth.

How we work

We're an in-office team in Edinburgh. We work together because it helps us collaborate closely across product, engineering, and legal teams. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

title: Support Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wordsmith
description_html:
Support Engineer

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

We’re hiring a Support Engineer to provide fast, thoughtful and technically rigorous help to Wordsmith customers.

You’ll own technical questions and incidents from first response through to resolution. You’ll understand what the customer is trying to achieve, reproduce reported behaviour, investigate the underlying cause and explain the outcome clearly.

This is more than scripted customer support. You’ll be expected to investigate application behaviour at a technical level, including reading logs and tracing issues through the product and its codebase. Where appropriate to your experience, you may also propose and submit code fixes through our normal engineering review and release process.

Wordsmith supports customers globally through a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the standard hours for your region and hand over unresolved issues clearly to colleagues in other regions. There is no routine expectation that you work another region’s hours.

What you’ll do

  • Own technical support requests — triage, investigate and resolve customer questions and incidents from first response to confirmed resolution.

  • Diagnose problems thoroughly — gather the right context, reproduce reported behaviour, inspect logs and data, and trace issues through the product and codebase.

  • Resolve technical issues — correct configuration or usage problems directly and collaborate with Engineering when a product or infrastructure change is required.

  • Contribute code fixes where appropriate — depending on your experience, propose and submit well-tested fixes through the standard engineering review and deployment process.

  • Communicate clearly — give customers timely and accurate updates, explain technical issues without unnecessary jargon and set honest expectations.

  • Manage escalations — bring in Engineering, Product or other specialists when needed while retaining ownership of the case and its communication.

  • Support global handovers — document investigation, impact, current status and next actions so colleagues in another region can continue work without losing momentum.

  • Protect service quality — recognise high-impact incidents quickly, follow the appropriate escalation process and contribute to incident reviews.

  • Build customer knowledge — create and maintain troubleshooting guides, known-issue documentation and help-centre content.

  • Reduce repeat problems — identify patterns in support demand and recommend improvements to the product, documentation, tooling and customer experience.

  • Improve support operations — help develop service levels, escalation paths, reporting and technical-support processes as the function scales.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in technical support, product support, software engineering, solutions engineering or another customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong diagnostic ability — you can work methodically from symptoms to root cause rather than relying on guesswork.

  • A working understanding of modern web applications, APIs, authentication, integrations and common browser or network issues.

  • Experience using diagnostic information such as application logs, monitoring tools, browser developer tools and database queries.

  • Enough familiarity with software code to navigate a codebase, follow application logic and use it to investigate reported behaviour.

  • Clear customer communication — you can remain calm under pressure, set expectations honestly and explain complex issues at the right level of detail.

  • Strong ownership — you remain responsible for moving an issue forward even when other teams need to contribute.

  • Sound prioritisation — you can assess urgency and customer impact and recognise when an issue requires immediate escalation.

  • Care and precision — you document what you tested, avoid unsupported conclusions and confirm that the customer’s problem has actually been resolved.

  • Interest in AI systems — you’re curious about how AI-enabled products behave and comfortable investigating issues that may not always be deterministic.

  • No legal background is required, but you should be motivated to learn how in-house legal teams work.

Desirable, but not essential

  • Experience writing and debugging production software.

  • The ability to create automated tests and submit code fixes for engineering review.

  • Experience supporting AI-enabled or data-intensive applications.

  • Familiarity with incident-management and observability tools.

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh. You should expect to work from the office as your default.

We support customers globally using a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the normal hours agreed for your region and create clear handovers when an issue needs to continue beyond them. Any exceptional on-call or out-of-hours arrangements would be agreed and communicated separately.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. Support is a core part of the product experience, and we expect it to be technically credible, responsive and human.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Transformation and Customer Success. Customer Success owns adoption and customer health; Transformation owns implementation; Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth; and Support Engineering owns technical investigation and resolution.

Why Wordsmith

You’ll support a fast-growing product used for important work inside some of the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Because we’re building in a new technical category, the problems are interesting. You’ll work across software behaviour, integrations, data and AI systems rather than following a script.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape our support tooling and operating model, influence the product through direct customer evidence, and develop towards senior support engineering, support leadership, solutions engineering or product engineering.

title: Sales Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Relay
description_html:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the Role

Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes — and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" — local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items.

Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling.

You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics — using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency.

What You'll Do

  • Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting.

  • Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals.

  • Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound.

  • Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild.

  • Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself.

  • Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process.

  • CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool.

  • Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business.

  • Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help.

  • High bar for quality. You insist on clean data and tight processes

  • Equally strong in detail and with people. You're comfortable refining a workflow in depth and equally at ease talking pipeline quality with sales.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

title: Staff Data Scientist - Network
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Relay
description_html:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the role

Relay's network runs on forecasts. Every shift released in sortation, every middle-mile van dispatched, every last-mile route planned, every expansion decision made - all downstream of models that predict how parcels move through our system. When those models are right, the network runs efficiently and cost per parcel drops. When they drift, the cost compounds across every stage of the operation. The Network squad builds and maintains the forecasting engine that powers all of it, and Demand Forecasting is its core: one forecast of what will be available to sort, at outcode granularity, from D0 out to D30.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you are the technical anchor for Demand Forecasting. You own the hardest and most ambiguous parts of the forecast, and you set the methodology and validation standards the rest of the area works to. That means owning the single integrated forecast of what volume the network will have to move, by area and out to thirty days, which the demand-management layer then turns into the operational plan the sort centres and transport teams run on. It means owning the model-driven end of that forecast, where the horizon runs past any live tracking data and expected parcels have to be generated from models rather than observed. It means owning the forecast of inbound international volume, one of the hardest prediction problems we have. And it means owning the models that predict each parcel's size and weight, which turn a parcel count into the physical volume that actually has to be sorted and loaded.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time building, not managing. You set the direction for how Demand Forecasting models, evaluates and ships its work, and you raise the technical bar across the area, but you do it as the most senior individual contributor in the room, on the tools. You'll work alongside a Senior Data Scientist who owns the domestic volume forecasts, an ML Engineer who keeps the models running reliably in production, and an Analyst who owns forecast accuracy and data quality. People leadership, strategy and cross-squad priorities sit with the Data Science Manager who leads the squad; you own the science.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 Data Engineers, Analysts, and Data Scientists, with specialists embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the Network squad and report into the centralised data team. Demand Forecasting is growing, and as its Staff DS you will have the deciding voice on its technical direction and the modelling approaches it adopts.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrated forecast end to end. Blend live tracking signals in the near term with model-generated parcels further out into a single view, by area, from today to thirty days ahead. This is the view the demand-management layer turns into the plan that Sortation, Middle Mile and Last Mile actually run on.

  • Build the hardest models in the area. The model-generated long-horizon forecast, the inbound-international volume forecast, and the parcel size and weight models that make the forecast a measure of physical volume rather than just a count. These are the ambiguous, high-leverage problems, and they are yours.

  • Set the methodology and validation standards for Demand Forecasting. Define how models are evaluated, how accuracy is measured at each horizon (a forecast made thirty days out shouldn't be held to the standard of one made two days out), and what "good" looks like across the area's models.

  • Raise the technical bar. Review approaches, make the model-choice and build-vs-buy calls, and mentor the Senior Data Scientist and Analyst alongside you, without taking on their line management.

  • Define the forecast's interfaces. Decide what Demand Forecasting hands to the demand-management layer, to Routing, and to the network-planning function: at what granularity, with what guarantees, and how error is attributed when a number turns out wrong.

  • Learn the operational processes your models serve, supported by the squad and the teams who use the forecasts, and identify where the current approach falls short.

  • Own production quality across the estate, working with the ML Engineer so that models are monitored, drift is caught early, and accuracy problems are traced to the right cause rather than re-tuned blindly.

  • Work with Finance, who extend the operational forecasts into longer-range financial projections, to keep the handoff between operational and financial models reliable.

  • Quantify the impact of model error on cost per parcel, and use it to decide where the area invests effort.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You have been the technical anchor on a modelling team before. You've owned the hardest problems, set the standards others worked to, and been the person the team turned to when an approach needed a call. You did it hands-on, as a senior IC, not by moving into management, and that's the path you want to keep on.

You think in interconnected systems. A demand forecast isn't just a number; it drives how many shifts are opened, how many vans are dispatched and how routes are planned, and it feeds a downstream planning decision and the network's expansion models. You care about how your models connect to the models around them, and you design their interfaces deliberately.

A deep track record of building and delivering models from ambiguous starting points. You understand the problem, build something useful, validate it against real operations, and iterate. You evaluate models well beyond standard offline metrics, connecting outputs to downstream applications and business KPIs and measuring how improvements translate into operational impact.

Strong Python and SQL, and depth across the full modelling lifecycle - from data extraction and feature engineering through training, validation and production deployment. You've worked with time-series forecasting across classical statistical approaches, gradient boosting and deep learning, and you understand the trade-offs well enough to make and defend the choice for a given problem. You'll be supported by a dedicated ML Engineer, but you set the standard for how the area's models are built.

At least 8 years in a data science or quantitative modelling role, with clear examples of models you built that informed operational or commercial decisions, and of methodology or technical direction you set for a team. You know a model isn't done when it trains well; it's done when it's running, monitored, and trusted.

You communicate with non-technical stakeholders with authority. The squads that consume the forecasts need to trust them, and that trust comes from explaining what the models do, where they're reliable, and where they're not, without hiding behind the maths.

You're comfortable using AI tools - LLMs, code assistants, and similar - to accelerate your workflow, from exploratory analysis to code generation, and you're curious about where these tools can augment the modelling process itself.

This role suits someone who wants to see whether their models made a real difference to how the network operates. There is a direct feedback loop between your work and operational outcomes, and as the Staff DS you own the most consequential end of it.

Logistics or delivery network experience is a plus, but what matters more is the ability to learn a complex operational domain quickly and model it well.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays.

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

description_html:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role:

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.

Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems. You maintain high standards for your team and aren’t afraid to say, “This needs improvement, and here’s why.” You ensure that the customer experience remains the focal point of every discussion, set SMART goals for performance improvement, and deliver feedback that aligns with our standards. You’re also hands-on, willing to dive into customer issues directly, and you become a product expert so that you can coach your agents effectively.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

  • Closely monitoring agent performance, primarily in terms of quality, productivity, and attendance metrics, with a primary goal of maintaining quality assurance scores above 90%

  • Providing frequent coaching to agents based QA feedback, metrics, customer survey responses, and your own ticket observations

  • Occasionally handling angry customer escalations

  • Ensure schedule adherence by agents and desired productivity levels

  • Maintaining coaching logs and providing regular written feedback to agents

  • Comfortably navigate our support environment, which includes tools such as Zendesk, Metabase, and Amazon Connect

  • Listen to team members’ feedback and resolve any challenges or conflicts

  • Initiate consequence management steps in the case of low-performing team members

  • Delegate tasks to high potential team members to build a culture of learning and development in the team

  • Suggest and lead team building activities for team motivation

Experience

  • 2+ years of coaching experience – Demonstrated success coaching individuals through structured feedback, development planning, and performance improvement.

  • 2+ years of people management experience – Experience leading customer support teams, driving performance, engagement, and accountability.

  • 2+ years of customer support experience – Strong foundation in delivering exceptional customer service and resolving complex customer issues.

What Success Looks Like in Worker Operations

  • Customer obsessed – Puts workers at the centre of every decision and consistently delivers a world-class experience.

  • Data-driven problem solver – Uses data, trends, and root cause analysis to identify issues and deliver sustainable improvements.

  • Thrives in ambiguity – Adapts quickly to changing priorities, products, and processes while maintaining high performance.

  • Communicates with clarity – Shares information proactively, aligns stakeholders, and provides clear, actionable feedback.

  • Bias for action – Takes ownership, moves with urgency, and focuses on delivering outcomes over perfection.

  • Continuously learns – Quickly develops expertise in new tools, products, and processes, applying that knowledge to improve both personal and team performance.

  • Raises the talent bar – Invests in coaching, challenges others to improve, and builds a culture of accountability and excellence.

  • Resilient under pressure – Maintains sound judgement and consistent execution during periods of high volume, incidents, and operational change.

System Requirements

  • Minimum 15Mbps wired internet connection

  • Minimum i5 processor or equivalent

  • Minimum 12GB Ram

  • Quiet working environment

  • Steady power and internet connection

Hiring Process

  • Application Review

  • Case Study

  • First Round Interview/Case Discussion

  • Interview with Head of Worker Support

This is a fully remote position. Team members are expected to maintain overlapping working hours with both EST and PST time zones and must be available for weekend shifts as needed.

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

title: Operations Strategy Associate
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Clipboard
description_html:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

The Operations Strategy Associate role is a generalist role at Clipboard suited for the “all-around athlete” type who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities.

You’re likely someone who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types, you’re resourceful, adaptable, and confident you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough. These are the ingredients for a problem-solver who is eager to flex into multiple different types of roles and responsibilities depending on what’s needed and most impactful.

While we know that you'll likely start working within one of our Operations teams, we don’t know exactly what work or projects you’ll drive out of the gate, so you’ll notice the work we’re advertising isn’t entirely specific. Some candidates may begin in more execution-focused roles within Operations, depending on their strengths, while others may take on project or team leadership earlier on.

But we’ll make a few promises about the role: it will be high-impact, fast-paced work that directly affects our customers, product, and business.

 

What You May Do

Because you'll be joining the business where your strengths and our highest priorities intersect, no two Associates have exactly the same experience. Here are a few examples of the types of work you may own:

  • Redesign our process for reaching out to workplaces about converting them to new methods of payment, such as getting customers who send checks to start paying us via eCheck to speed up the cash conversion process.

  • Research, vet, and onboard a new vendor that embeds AI agents into our customer-facing efforts.

  • Build an internal predictive analytics model to catch bad payers earlier with high accuracy.

  • Spearhead a quality task force that ensures top quality for our biggest customers.

  • Manage a team of agents within one of our Operations teams.

  • Work directly within workflows, including handling customer interactions, resolving issues, and identifying opportunities to improve the front line processes.

 

Who we're looking for

We find those who are most successful in this type of role:

  • Are insatiably curious and notice non-obvious clues and patterns: Curiosity sits atop our company values. Understanding something from first principles and getting to the root cause of the problem will often reveal the best solution, and a natural and unwavering curiosity to keep asking questions and digging will take you most of the way.

  • Roll up their sleeves and go to the source: There are multiple ways to say this: touching reality, dogfooding, seeing for yourself, going to the front-lines, etc. Don’t just take someone’s word for it – go find out yourself by testing the feature, or listening to the agent call, or calling the customer, or executing the workflow. This is how you seek truth.

  • Bring a tenacity and persistence to problem-solving: You’ll hit walls and find yourself in uncertain and unfamiliar situations. If you can sit with the uncertainty, look at the problem from new angles, and keep applying pressure to a problem – you’ll position yourself for breakthroughs.

  • Bounce back from failure quickly: You’ll make mistakes, move in the wrong direction, and stumble from time-to-time. Just avoid big mistakes and don’t make the same mistakes twice, and learn from them quickly. Worry less about failing and more about losing momentum in your feedback loop. If you fail cheaply and quickly, that's worth the lesson/learning you get in return.

     

We are hiring multiple people and will continue hiring indefinitely for this role. We won’t close the funnel prematurely based on other candidates, but may periodically pause applications due to volume. We will hire everyone who meets our threshold of excellence and hope you meet our criteria.

 

We do not require any experience for this role. Experience will be taken into consideration for both (a) the work you’re placed into once hired and (b) compensation. In addition to experience, these two items are determined by performance during the interview process.

 

Why Join Clipboard?

  • We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

  • Fast-Paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

  • A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.

 

Hiring Process

  1. Application

  2. Case Study

  3. Case Interview(s) our Operations Leaders

  4. Interview with our Head of Operations

  5. Interview with one of our Co-CEOs

 

*After submitting your application, please check your spam folder periodically over the next few days for updates.

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation: $50K – $80K

description_html:
Mit Freude an der Arbeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein bei allem, was wir tun – so arbeiten wir. Als TOP‑Arbeitgeber schafft unsere Bank dafür die besten Rahmenbedingungen. Rund 650 engagierte Mitarbeitende und eine Bilanzsumme von etwa 5,2 Milliarden Euro machen uns zu einer der großen Regionalbanken im Westmünsterland: Hier sind wir verwurzelt, hier setzen wir uns ein – für eine starke Wirtschaft, eine nachhaltige Lebensqualität und ein persönlich-digitales Banking. Wir begleiten Mitglieder und Kunden auch Durch anspruchsvollste Themen. Unser Geschäftsgebiet erstreckt sich über das westliche und südliche Münsterland bis an die Grenze des Ruhrgebiets.

Aufgaben

Das können Sie bei uns gestalten:

  • Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich die Sichtung und fachliche Bewertung aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen und Änderungen im Wertpapier- und Passivgeschäft.
  • Sie wirken an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und Arbeitsgruppen mit.
  • Sie tragen zu einer kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung bei und stellen in Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen eine erforderliche Dokumentation der Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation sicher.
  • Sie unterstützen die Marktfolge Passiv/Wertpapiere sowie die Vertriebseinheiten bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen im operativen Geschäft. Dabei zählen die Entwicklung von Maßnahmen zur Steigerung der Prozess- als auch Datenqualität zu Ihren Kernaufgaben.
  • Ferner wirken Sie bei der Entwicklung von Maßnahmenplänen zur Behebung identifizierter Schwachstellen mit.
  • Sie stehen als Ansprechpartner für Spezialthemen, Prüfaufträge oder Machbarkeitsstudien zur Verfügung.

Qualifikation

Das macht Sie aus:

  • Sie verfügen über eine fundierte Bankausbildung oder vergleichbare Ausbildung mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusatzqualifikation oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium.
  • Sie verfügen im Idealfall über langjährige Berufserfahrung im Wertpapier- und Passivgeschäft einer Bank idealerweise gepaart mit Kenntnissen zu aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen.
  • Sie überzeugen durch analytisches Denken, sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikationsstärke.
  • Sie bringen ein hohes Maß an Engagement und Leistungsbereitschaft mit, wobei Teamgeist und der Wunsch, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, zu Ihrem Selbstverständnis gehören.

Benefits

Was Sie von uns erwarten dürfen:

  • Bei uns erwartet Sie eine Arbeitskultur, in der Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Fairness selbstverständlich sind. Die Unterzeichnungen der Charta der Vielfalt, der Charta des Ehrenamts und der Charta der Pflege unterstreichen dieses Selbstverständnis.
  • Wir leben ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Miteinander in einem engagierten, professionellen Team.
  • Sie finden flexible, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeit‑ und Arbeitsort-modelle – weil Lebensentwürfe unterschiedlich sind.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen attraktive und bedarfsgerechte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Sie arbeiten beim TOP Employer 2026; übrigens wurden wir nun schon zum 19. Mal ausgezeichnet.
  • Auf Sie warten interessante Benefits z.B. Bike-Leasing, Deutschlandticket als Jobticket, Essenschecks, PC-Leasing, Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio (EGYM Wellpass) etc.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung

title: Retail Managerial Opportunities at Oysho
description_html:
About the job

 

Managerial Opportunities at OYSHO- London Area

About us:

Inditex is one of the largest fashion distribution groups in the world, with seven commercial brands: Zara, Pull&Bear, Massimo Dutti, Bershka, Stradivarius, Oysho and Zara Home. We are what you wear to work, what you decide to decorate your life with, what you choose for that special occasion.

We love what we do. Teamwork, passion, curiosity, diversity, sustainability, creativity and humility are the daily motivation for the more than 174,000 individuals who make up the Inditex group.

How we imagine you:

We are seeking passionate people that are looking for a challenging yet rewarding career in fashion. The ideal candidate will have a track record of commerciality ,people management and understanding of customer service .You will work in a fast –paced environment and you will be able to multi task between your key responsibilities

What we expect from you:

Our Managers ensure that the business is run efficiently by encouraging the team and controlling the product and commerciality of the store. Some of your responsibilities will be to:

  • Monitor and analyse commercial and product data to improve the sales and productivity of your store

  • Oversee the store’s operational tasks

  • Motivate and develop your team

  • Be an ambassador for our companies sustainability project

What we offer:

In addition to a competitive salary, you will also receive 25% discount to buy the latest trends in any of our brands, company pension scheme, holiday allowance of 28 days and a ‘More For Less’  benefit package where you can find a wide range of discounts.

Our internal talent is our greatest asset and we are proud of offering internal promotion programmes where you will find opportunities to grow, e-learning and training programmes - we never stop learning! Social projects to get involved in and contribute to a better society and much more!

We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment processes are barrier free and as inclusive as possible to everyone .This includes making adjustments for people with disabilities or long term conditions.

INDINDITEXSM
