title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ANGEHEUERT GmbH
description_html:
Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡

Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land.

As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg, you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults.

You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future. Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure.

Your Benefits

• Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form.

• Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures.

• Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments.

• Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs.

• Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases.

• Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience.

Your Responsibilities

As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the reliable technical operation of the road based power plant in Hamburg.

• Maintenance and repairs: Inspect and maintain the system across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components. Your responsibilities will also include tasks such as monitoring and maintaining the hydraulic oil.

• Troubleshooting: Analyse technical issues, resolve faults, and document both the solution and the underlying cause.

• Service development: Create and continuously improve maintenance schedules, spare parts lists, and technical service documentation for the system.

• Spare parts management: Keep track of spare parts stored on site and ensure they are managed in a structured and reliable way.

Your Profile as a Maintenance Technician

• You have a technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology, or a comparable technical qualification.

• You have practical experience in the mechanical maintenance and repair of technical systems or machinery.

• You have a solid understanding of hydraulic systems and are able to independently understand technical relationships and identify potential issues.

• You are available for 20 to 30 hours per week and are flexible enough to occasionally work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when suitable maintenance windows are available at the terminal.

• You enjoy taking responsibility, work independently, and remain calm and solution oriented when dealing with technical problems.

• You enjoy working directly on technical equipment and outdoors and feel comfortable in an active traffic and logistics environment.

• The ability to confidently read technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and electrical circuit diagrams is an advantage.

Would you like to do more than simply maintain a globally unique GreenTech system and actively help shape how its future operation and service structure are developed? ⚡

Then send us your CV and learn more about the company, the technology, and your future role in a short ten minute introductory call.

description_html:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.  

  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. 

Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀 

Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die IT Landschaft und die Möglichkeiten, die du in dieser Rolle hast.

title: Staff Software Engineer (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Distribusion Technologies
description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity
We are searching for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Search team. The role entails contributing to the product & technical domains of excellence in the main API product that enables large retailers to seamlessly purchase tickets from bus & rail carriers worldwide. The team enables a booking system that includes booking orchestration, invoicing, ticketing, and more.

What you will do:

  • Drive the strategic architectural transition of our core Search Engine from Elixir to Go as the pioneer Go engineer.

  • Design foundational infrastructure for high-throughput microservices to ensure smooth interoperability between the new Go architecture and legacy systems.

  • Own the technical backlog and success metrics while coordinating cross-functional work to strictly align with long-term business objectives.

  • Resolve technical bottlenecks and guide teams to build solutions that maximize business value and justify migration decisions.

  • Lead company-wide technology adoption and agile engineering processes while maintaining highly effective documentation.

  • Systematically elevate the team's technical capabilities by upskilling your peers in Go best practices.

Workplace: Berlin

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in Golang.

  • You ideally have some knowledge of Ruby or Python to effectively navigate our legacy ecosystem and drive the transition.

  • You have deep architectural mastery of high-throughput distributed systems, microservices, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and GCP.

  • You can seamlessly translate complex technical decisions into business metrics to identify and resolve growth hurdles.

  • You excel at cross-functional leadership, synchronizing technologies and ensuring total transparency between developers, partners, and stakeholders.

  • You champion an agile mindset, test-driven development, and robust CI/CD pipelines to maximize efficiency during technical transitions.

  • You are deeply passionate about continuous self-development and actively mentoring others.

  • You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at (Come join us!

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in Germany.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories.
  • Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats.
  • Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories.
  • Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process.
  • Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows.
  • Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field.
    • Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers.
    • Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly.
    • Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats.
    • Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings.
    • Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts.
    • Comfortable working across multiple content formats and adapting technical material for different audiences and channels.
    • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted content or research workflows, using these tools to enhance productivity while maintaining personal editorial judgement and authorship.
    • Curiosity about emerging developments in AI, machine learning, and scientific research.
    • Strong attention to accuracy, fact-checking, and technical detail.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively with researchers, designers, and multimedia professionals.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they are based.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation through a fixed monthly contract retainer.
      • Ongoing contract engagement with opportunities for professional growth and potential transition to a full-time position.
      • Flexible working arrangements within Europe.
      • High degree of ownership over research, editorial projects, and storytelling formats.
      • Opportunities to work on impactful projects at the forefront of AI and machine learning.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Collaboration with researchers, engineers, scientific leaders, designers, and multimedia professionals.
      • International working environment with talented teams across multiple locations.
      • Opportunity to experiment with AI tools, agents, coding, and automation in modern editorial workflows.
      • Fast-moving environment where innovative ideas and individual contributions can have a visible impact.

Du wirst Teil unseres Teams an der Schnittstelle zwischen internationalem Handel, Exportkontrolle und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft bei STARK. Von Anfang an arbeitest du an realen Fällen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen internationalen Umfeld.


Your mission

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Exportkontrolle unterstützt du uns dabei, nationale und internationale Exportkontrollvorgaben zuverlässig in unsere täglichen Geschäftsprozesse zu integrieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen und unterstützt bei konkreten Fragestellungen rund um Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogene Restriktionen.

Dabei erhältst du direkten Einblick in reale Fälle des internationalen Handels- und Exportkontrollrechts und kannst dein theoretisches Wissen unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden.


Responsibilities

  • Du beantwortest tägliche Fragen aus Fachabteilungen, zum Beispiel Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik, zu exportkontrollrelevanten Abläufen und Prüfschritten.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Exportkontrolle, Zoll, Compliance oder Außenwirtschaft, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten

description_html:
About Us

STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. We
design, develop and manufacture software-defined, mass-scalable and cost-effective platforms that give
NATO operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We are focused on delivering
deployable, high-performance capability — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, our work
strengthens the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners.


Your mission

Your mission is to work hands-on with the parts of the aircraft that turn stored energy into flight: the
motors, the batteries, and the propulsion and power components that decide how far, how fast, and how
long our platforms fly. You support the hardware team from bench characterisation through data analysis
in MATLAB and Python.

You aren't just swapping components on a bench; you are helping generate the measured evidence that
decides what actually flies — and learning how unmanned hardware is designed, tested, and pushed to its
limits.


Responsibilities

● Support characterisation and bench testing of motors, propellers, batteries, and power
components for our UAS platforms.
● Help set up test rigs and instrumentation, and capture clean, repeatable measurement data.
● Assist with component selection and trade-offs by turning test data into clear comparisons.
● Reduce and analyse test data in MATLAB and Python — efficiency, thrust, endurance, thermal and
discharge behaviour.
● Visualise results so the engineering team can make decisions from them quickly.
● Keep test setups, measurements, and findings documented and traceable.


Qualifications

● Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, or a comparable
engineering field.
● Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python for data analysis.
● Interest in and some exposure to UAS, electric propulsion (motors / ESCs), or battery / power
systems.
● Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
● Practical, hands-on mindset — comfortable at the bench and with a multimeter as much as in a
script.
● Good written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus
● Hands-on: You like building, measuring, and finding out what really happens.
● Rigorous: You trust clean measurements over assumptions.
● Curious: You want to understand why a component behaves the way it does.


Nice to have

● Experience with test benches, DAQ, or measurement instrumentation.
● Familiarity with battery testing, thermal behaviour, or motor/propeller characterisation.
● Personal projects with drones, RC aircraft, batteries, or robotics

description_html:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution.


Your mission

You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Translate Needs: Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team.

  • Push the Backlog: Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones.

  • Drive Execution: Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly.

  • Document Capabilities: Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver.

  • Evaluate & Accept Work: Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms.

  • Technical Literacy: You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers.

  • Systems Thinking: A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers.


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration.

  • Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context.

  • Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors.

We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

title: Tactical Data Link Expert (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stark
description_html:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.


Your mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.


Responsibilities

Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.

Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.

Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.

SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.

Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.

Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.

Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.


Qualifications

Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.

Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.

Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.

Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.

Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.

Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.

Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.

Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.

Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.


Nice to have

 Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.

· Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.

· Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.

· Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.

· Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

title: Senior Waveform Architect (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Stark
description_html:
About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline.


About the team

We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, seeking visionary technical leaders who can define long-term technology roadmaps while remaining deeply hands-on with complex engineering problems. On the Electronic Warfare team, you will hold the highest level of technical authority for our attack and countermeasure capabilities, driving multi-domain architectures directly onto the modern battlefield.


Your mission

At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Waveform Architect, you will own the entire development, architecture, and implementation of the waveform for our tactical anti-jam radio. In this critical role, you will ensure our communication links remain highly robust and operational under severe electronic countermeasure conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of the physical layer (PHY)—waveform, modulation, coding, framing, and synchronisation—from initial architecture to real-time execution.
  • Engineer solutions specifically tailored for challenging jamming scenarios and complex, multi-node long-range link budgets.
  • Own the PHY-side specifications and expose the critical IQ, phase, and timing observables required by the Direction Finding (DF) strand.
  • Define the development guidelines for the strand—including HDL and verification conventions, as well as FPGA build flows.


Qualifications

  • You have successfully designed a PHY and brought it onto FPGA/SoC hardware in real time.
  • You are quantitatively sure-footed on synchronisation, estimation, FEC (Forward Error Correction), and link budgets.
  • You have practical experience debugging real radio links against physical hardware.


Nice to have

  • Experience with anti-jamming and LPI/LPD (Low Probability of Intercept/Detection) in a tactical context.
  • A professional background at industry leaders.
  • Publicly verifiable PHY implementation evidence (e.g., custom GNU Radio OOT modules or contributions to the RFSoC toolchain).

About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline.


About the team

We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, looking for proactive engineers who are excited to take mathematical models off the whiteboard and deploy them onto physical hardware. On our Electronic Warfare algorithms team, you will bridge the gap between theoretical signal processing and real-world hardware execution, taking direct ownership of key software and firmware modules.


Your mission

At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer you will solve the critical challenges of directional wireless communication in highly dynamic networks. You will design and implement the medium access control (MAC) and routing layers that allow our platforms to form robust, self-healing networks under demanding tactical conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement MAC protocols and routing algorithms tailored for directional multi-node systems, directly tackling the challenge of neighbour discovery under highly focused, narrow beams.
  • Build dynamic TDMA schedules and beam coordination mechanisms in lockstep with the physical layer (PHY) and antenna steering systems, ensuring routing decisions are grounded in real-time RF characteristics rather than simple hop counts.
  • Deliver resilient multi-hop relay capabilities that sustain high-bandwidth video and control links between mobile platforms over tactical distances, routing back seamlessly to ground control stations under dynamic conditions.
  • Build and maintain multi-node Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds alongside automated logging pipelines to quantitatively evaluate and verify network join times and topology reform behaviours.
  • Mesh networking in a product that shipped — sim work alone does not qualify — plus Linux networking at kernel and packet level with live debugging.
  • Radio-literate and has designed a medium-access scheme or TDMA schedule.


Qualifications

  • You have successfully designed and shipped mesh networking protocols in commercial or defence products.
  • Deep, practical familiarity with the Linux networking stack at the kernel and packet levels, coupled with strong live-debugging skills on embedded systems.
  • Strong understanding of wireless propagation and physical layer realities, with hands-on experience designing medium-access control schemes or TDMA schedulers.


Nice to have

  • Active contributions to open-source routing protocols (e.g., batman-adv, olsrd, Babel).
  • A professional background at tactical mesh vendors (such as Silvus, Persistent Systems, TrellisWare, Saab, or Bittium).
  • Experience with mmWave backhaul systems or other technologies where directional beamforming is the default mode of operation.
  • Batman-adv / olsrd / Babel contributor; tactical mesh vendor background (Silvus, Persistent, TrellisWare, Saab, Bittium); mmWave backhaul — already thinks in beams.

description_html:
About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining how autonomous and electronic warfare systems are engineered and deployed. We design, build, and operationalise high-performance electronic warfare (EW) and unmanned systems that provide NATO forces with decisive advantages in contested electromagnetic environments. Our work is grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline, giving you the opportunity to lead alongside world-class industrial design and EW experts.


About the team

We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, looking for senior engineers who thrive on end-to-end technical leadership and cross-domain problem solving. In this role, you will have the mandate to architect critical hardware, mentor high-performing teams, take decisive action, and see your systems operate in the field.


Your mission

You will architect and drive the design, integration, and deployment of mission-critical Electronic Warfare (EW) capabilities across STARK’s platforms. Serving as a technical authority for critical hardware and RF systems, you will guide architecture from concept through simulation, layout, and field validation, ensuring our platforms deliver decisive overmatch in complex, dynamic RF environments.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end board design using Altium Designer, setting standards for High-Density Interconnect (HDI) techniques, stackup strategies, and complex high-frequency routing.

  • Oversee the design, simulation, and implementation of custom RF components, matching networks, and signal conditioning chains for contested environments.

  • Direct antenna design and placement simulations using CST Studio Suite and Altair FEKO to optimize platform-level RF performance and mitigate co-site interference.

  • Drive the mechanical packaging and electro-mechanical integration of hardware systems, collaborating with software, firmware, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless platform deployment.

  • Establish rigorous testing, debugging, and validation frameworks to guarantee hardware survivability and performance against strict defence and environmental standards.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs, and contribute to long-term hardware roadmaps and architectural decisions.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional engineering experience leading complex electronic, RF, or hardware systems development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Altium Designer, with a track record of successfully bringing complex HDI, high-speed, and high-frequency PCBs to production.

  • Deep experience in RF circuit design, matching network optimization, and electromagnetic simulation using CST Studio Suite, Altair FEKO, or similar tools.

  • Proven ability to define multi-layer hardware architectures and translate broad operational requirements into robust engineering specifications.

  • Demonstrated track record of technical ownership in fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environments.

  • Advanced system-level debugging capability across hardware, RF, software, and firmware boundaries.

  • B.S. or M.S. in Electrical, Electronic, Telecommunications, or Mechatronics Engineering (or equivalent experience).

  • Direct experience in Defence, Aerospace, Telecommunications, or high-reliability hardware sectors.

  • Deep familiarity with RF spectrum management, signal processing techniques, or Software-Defined Radio (SDR) architectures.

title: Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stark
description_html:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company, revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.


About the team

You will be working closely with the Flight Test Team and reporting to the Technical Director.


Your mission

As a Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator, you are the "Conductor of the Flight Line." Depending on your seniority, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our flight test campaigns, from initial planning and hazard assessment to execution and deep-dive data analysis.
Beyond the technical data, you serve as the primary Onsite Leader. You are the person who ensures testing priorities are crystal clear to everyone on the range. You manage the daily tempo, coordinate the crew, and ensure that every person, from pilots to software engineers, knows exactly which tests are being conducted and when. Your mission is to transform raw flight data into actionable insights while maintaining a high-tempo, disciplined, and safe testing environment.




Responsibilities

Onsite Test Coordination & Leadership

  • Act as the Onsite Test Coordinator: Lead daily operations on the range, ensuring the team stays focused on the primary test objectives.
  • Clarify Priorities: Maintain and communicate the "Daily Flight Schedule," ensuring everyone knows the sequence of events and current testing priorities.
  • Lead Briefings: Drive the morning "Pre-Flight Brief" and the evening "Debrief," capturing critical feedback and setting goals for the following day.
  • Resource Management: Coordinate the availability of airframes, ground support equipment, and personnel to maximize range time efficiency.
Flight Execution & Safety
  • Coordinate and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with regulatory requirements and STARK safety standards.
  • Ensure all flight activities and anomalies are documented with high fidelity.
  • Develop specific Flight Test Techniques (FTTs) and instrumentation requirements to capture critical performance metrics.
  • Lead Flight Readiness Reviews (FRR) and contribute to safety review boards.
Test Design & Data Analysis
  • Develop comprehensive flight test plans, test cards, and rigorous flight test hazard assessments (FTHA).
  • Process and analyze flight data using MATLAB or Python to validate system performance against requirements.
  • Work closely with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems to iterate on flight behavior and performance.
  • Manage the configuration of flight test articles, ensuring all hardware and software versions are meticulously tracked.


Qualifications

Educational & Legal Background

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or higher in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering.
  • NATO Citizenship: Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
  • Communication: Professional-level written and verbal English.
Technical & Leadership Toolkit
  • Coordination Skills: Proven ability to lead a technical team on-site (three pilots and one engineer), manage schedules, and communicate priorities clearly under pressure.
  • Data Mastery: Practical experience in data reduction and analysis using MATLAB or Python.
  • UAV Systems: Familiarity with Ground Control Stations (GCS), telemetry systems, and mission planning tools.
  • Testing Rigor: Proven ability to plan and conduct system-level tests in an aerospace or defense environment.
Mindset & Style
  • The "General" Mindset: You are naturally organized and can work through ambiguity on the flight line.
  • Analytical & Decisive: You can analyze a data anomaly quickly and decide whether to continue testing.
  • Meticulous Documenter: You believe that if it wasn't documented with high fidelity, the test never happened.
Preferred Experience
  • Active experience with uncrewed aviation.
  • Hands-on experience with flight test instrumentation (FTI) and DAQ systems.
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation environments.

title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mway
description_html:
Your mission

You want to do more than just contribute ideas — you want to actively shape a software product from the first concept through to release? As Product Owner at Relution, you take responsibility for the continued development of our “Made in Germany” UEM and MDM platform.

You will work closely with customers, Engineering, UX, Sales and Management. You understand requirements, challenge assumptions and work with the team to turn real problems into meaningful product solutions.

  • You monitor the UEM and MDM market, analyse competitors and technology trends, and contribute insights to our product strategy and roadmap
  • You gather and evaluate requirements from customers across education, public sector, healthcare and enterprise, as well as from partners, Sales and Management
  • You prioritise topics based on customer value, strategic relevance and effort, and take ownership of the product backlog for your areas
  • You challenge requirements, identify the underlying problem and work with UX and Engineering to develop the right solution
  • You translate requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria and support implementation from concept through to release
  • You work closely with our development teams in a technically demanding environment covering Apple, Android Enterprise and Windows
  • You work on topics such as device management, enterprise app management, security, identity, APIs and platform integrations
  • You collect feedback on new functionality and continuously improve existing features
  • You represent Relution as a product expert in customer and partner discussions, at trade fairs, webinars and training sessions
  • For complex functional or technical topics, you support the wider team and ensure that relevant insights feed back into the product


Your Course

  • You have several years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a comparable role for a software product
  • You understand technical concepts, can discuss them with developers on an equal footing and are able to explain complex topics clearly and concisely
  • You combine technical understanding with a strong business mindset and want to take responsibility for a successful B2B software product
  • You are able to structure and prioritise requirements and are comfortable making clear decisions about what should — and should not — be built
  • Experience with Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Mobile Device Management (MDM), Enterprise Mobility, IT security or comparable B2B software products is a strong advantage — but not a requirement
  • A degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering or a comparable field is beneficial — but your experience, product mindset and technical curiosity matter more to us
  • You communicate clearly, enjoy working across different teams and take ownership of your topics
  • Very good German and good English skills complete your profile


Your profile

  • You are given responsibility and the freedom to make your own decisions
  • We work closely together and value direct communication over lengthy coordination processes
  • We want you to challenge requirements rather than simply accept them and help us find the best solution for the product
  • We continuously improve our processes instead of simply maintaining them
  • You do not need to meet every requirement from day one — willingness to learn and technical curiosity matter just as much as experience


What´s important to us

  • The ability to work independently as part of a team that supports you rather than leaving you on your own
  • Open communication instead of lengthy coordination loops
  • A desire to question processes and improve them rather than just managing them
  • Apply even if you don’t meet all the criteria 100% – a willingness to learn counts just as much as experience to us


Why us?

  • Flexible working: Flexible working hours, transparent time tracking, part-time options and a hybrid working model with plenty of flexibility regarding where you work
  • 30 days of holiday + 6 flex days: Giving you enough time to recharge outside of work
  • A strong start: Mentoring from day one to help you quickly get up to speed with the product and the team
  • Macademy: Our own development programme for everyone who wants to grow professionally and personally
  • Stay mobile: We subsidise your Deutschlandticket
  • Get on your bike: (E-)bike leasing through JobRad, with our own bicycle storage and showers at the office
  • Plan ahead: Company pension scheme included
  • Well looked after: Subsidised lunch in our canteen and free drinks throughout the day
  • Stay active: Wellpass or Urban Sports Club — whichever suits you best
  • Team moments: Regular team events and activities
  • Our home in Stuttgart: Modern, bright offices with excellent public transport connections
We were recognised by FOCUS-Business as one of Germany’s Top Employers among medium-sized companies in 2026.

If you want to help shape a technically sophisticated software product and take real ownership of the future development of Relution, we look forward to hearing from you.

description_html:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institut für Sozialwissenschaften ist eine von Bund und Ländern finanzierte, international tätige sozialwissenschaftliche Einrichtung der Leibniz-Gemeinschaft. 
 
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für den Standort Köln in der Abteilung Data Services for the Social Sciences, Team Data Aquisition and Access (DAA) eine
 
Studentische Hilfskraft
(15,20 € / 16,09 € Stundenlohn, 10 Wochenstunden, befristet)
 
Die Abteilung Data Services for the Social Sciences bietet nachhaltige Infrastrukturen und Dienstleistungen für Management, Kuration und Langzeitarchivierung von Forschungsdaten. Ihr Ziel ist es, FAIRe Daten, offene Wissenschaft und reproduzierbare Forschung in den quantitativen und computergestützten Sozialwissenschaften zu fördern. Dazu bietet die Abteilung u.a. Datenservices zur Kuration, Veröffentlichung, Registrierung und Archivierung von Daten für einzelne Forscher*innen, Projekte und Institutionen an, stellt Zugänge zu sensiblen Daten bereit und führt Schulungen und Beratungen zum Management von Forschungsdaten durch.


Ihr Aufgabengebiet:

  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau eines Kundenverwaltungssystems
  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung von Serviceaufträgen bei der Datenarchivierung
  • Recherche für methodische Forschung zum Forschungsdatenmanagement - FDM (Data Sharing, Datenarchivierung)


Ihr Profil:

  • Sehr guter Bachelor-Abschluss in einem quantitativ ausgerichteten sozialwissenschaftlichen Fach
  • Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Literaturverwaltungsprogrammen wünschenswert
  • Erfahrungen im Bereich Webseitenbetreuung wünschenswert
  • Selbständige, proaktive Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit


Wir bieten:

  • Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten und vertiefte Einblicke in alle Bereiche des FDM vom Projektdesign bis zum Projektabschluss
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Kostenfreie Teilnahme an den Weiterbildungen von GESIS Training
  • Sehr gute Bedingungen für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie
  • Ganzheitliches Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und die vergünstigte Teilnahme am Sportprogramm der Uni

title: Student Research Assistant, Team Survey Data Augmentation (SHK-SDC-23)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GESIS – Leibniz-Institut für Sozialwissenschaften
description_html:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting as soon as possible, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Curations, located in Cologne, is looking for one or two
 
Student Research Assistants
(15,20 € / 16,09 € hourly rate, up to 19 hrs./ month, temporary)
 

The department „Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. The “Survey Data Augmentation” team specializes in developing methods for linking survey data with other types of data, such as georeferenced data, with a focus on democracy research. We are part of the emerging European data infrastructure “Monitoring Electoral Democracy” (https://medem.eu/).


Your tasks will be:

  • Supporting the team’s full range of service and research activities in the office in Cologne
  • Data collection and management
  • Analysis and visualization of research data
  • Literature research
  • Assisting with the preparation of events such as methodology courses and research workshops


Your profile:

  • Enrolled student in the social sciences (political science, sociology, or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of quantitative methods
  • Experience with the R programming language and the Zotero bibliography management tool is a plus
  • Interest in research on democracy or social science methods
  • Good command of English; German is a plus


Our Benefits:

  • Participation in research and service activities related to academic studies
  • Experience in data management and analysis relevant to a wide range of career fields
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working
  • Very good conditions for reconciling work and family life
  • Holistic company health management and discounted participation in the university's sports programme 
  • Promotion of your skills through further training measures


Contact

For further information concerning the tasks please contact Sebastian Ziaja via e-mail (). If you have questions about the application process, please contact Christine Laßmann via e-mail ().


Interested?

Please apply until October 5, 2026 via our Online-application portal.
 
Our reference number is: SHK-SDC-23

title: Postdoctoral Researcher in geocoded electoral data (SDC-34)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GESIS – Leibniz-Institut für Sozialwissenschaften
description_html:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on January 1, 2027, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Postdoctoral Researcher in geocoded electoral data
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 100 %, limited to 3 years)
 

The department „Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. “Electoral Spaces” is a project of our team Survey Data Augmentation that develops a research data infrastructure for making geocoded electoral data more findable, accessible, interoperable, and re-usable.


Your tasks will be:

  • Leading the development of data curation, validation, and spatial aggregation tools for geocoded electoral data using the statistical software R
  • Establishing a framework clarifying legal, ethical, and licensing conditions for data provision and reuse
  • Supporting the principal investigators in coordinating the overall project and managing workflows and project knowledge
  • Creating user documentation, training materials, and public interfaces for the infrastructure
  • Conducting methodological or applied research showcasing the added value of the infrastructure


Your profile:

  • Completed academic university degree (Master’s or equivalent) and completed PhD in political science, quantitative social science, spatial data science, or a related discipline
  • Advanced expertise in longitudinal and spatial data integration, provenance documentation, and reproducible workflows
  • Proficiency in coding and managing spatial datasets in R, with experience in version control and data curation standards
  • Track record of contributing to empirical research and generating scientific innovation with data infrastructure
  • Excellent English language skills


Our Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to a research data infrastructure with substantial impact on the future of democracy research
  • Work in an integrated yet flexible team of quantitative social scientists with substantial synergies between survey augmentation projects specializing in geospatial data applications and democracy
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working

title: Postdoctoral Researcher for Longitudinal Surveys (DRS-57)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GESIS – Leibniz-Institut für Sozialwissenschaften
description_html:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute and member of the Leibniz Association, funded by federal and state governments.
 
Starting on 01.01.2027 our Department Data and Research on Society, Team Social Surveys located in Mannheim, is looking for a
 
Postdoctoral Researcher for Longitudinal Surveys (Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 100 %, Limitation for two years)
 

Monitoring current social developments is a primary objective of the social sciences. The department Data and Research on Society supports the social sciences in this task, by providing comprehensive data and tools to describe and analyse social changes. The department is responsible, among others for the implementation of the renowned European Social Survey (ESS) in Germany, and for the first time also for the collection of German data for the CROss-National Online Survey (CRONOS), implemented within the ESS framework. The CRONOS sample in Germany was recruited in the 12th ESS round, respondents will be invited to participate in at least two panel waves.


Your tasks will be:

  • Planning and implementing CRONOS within the framework of the EU-funded INNOVATE Project initiated by ESS ERIC and further partners, in close cooperation with partners within and outside the institute 
  • Planning and implementing the 13th round of the European Social Surveys (ESS) in Germany 
  • Planning, coordinating and contributing to the German Translation of the ESS Source Questionnaire, and the fieldwork materials for the 13th round of ESS and for CRONOS
  • Checking and processing the data collected in the ESS and in CRONOS in Germany during and after the data collection
  • Presenting and publishing ESS-relevant research in scientific conferences and journals


Your profile:

  • Above-average completed PhD (as well as a Master) in the Social Sciences (for example Sociology, Political Science, Social Psychology, Survey Methodology)
  • Sound knowledge in empirical quantitative social research including the use of statistical analysis methods and programs (Stata, R)
  • Excellent German language skills and very good Englisch skills in speaking and writing
  • Ability to plan and implement projects efficiently, coupled with an independent and proactive working style as well as good inter-personal communication and collaboration skills
  • Practical experience in the implementation of social-scientific surveys is of advantage


Our Benefits:

  • The possibility to gain valuable knowledge and experience in one of the most renowned international survey programs in Europe (Project and data management, data processing and an international network)
  • Participation in the implementation of an established international repeated cross-sectional Survey and the establishment of a new international panel in Germany
  • An attractive working environment with a friendly and collegial atmosphere
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working

description_html:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on January 1, 2027, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Doctoral Researcher in spatial data management
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 75 %, limited to 3 years)
 

The department “Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. “Electoral Spaces” is a project of our team Survey Data Augmentation that develops a research data infrastructure for making geocoded electoral data more findable, accessible, interoperable, and re-usable.


Your tasks will be:

  • Setting up the data storage technology and programming the R interface and auxiliary tools for “Electoral Spaces”
  • Testing and assessing the tech stack to ensure it meets researchers' needs for spatial electoral data
  • Supporting data modeling, data ingestion pipelines, and curation workflows
  • Contributing to technical documentation, project outreach, and dissemination
  • Conducting methodological or applied research showcasing the added value of the infrastructure


Your profile:

  • Master’s degree in geography, geoinformatics, spatial data science, or a related discipline
  • Technical literacy in geospatial software stacks and strong programming skills in R
  • Strong interest in the application of GIS and spatial data to political and social science research
  • Motivation to complete a PhD thesis closely aligned with the project
  • Excellent English language skills


Our Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to a research data infrastructure with substantial impact on the future of democracy research
  • Work in an integrated yet flexible team of quantitative social scientists with substantial synergies between survey augmentation projects specializing in geospatial data applications and democracy
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working

description_html:
Your role with us

For our Solution Engineering team we're looking for an SAP SD developer/consultant. At Workist, our Solution Engineering team works directly with our customers to connect their ERP (e.g. sAP) systems to our AI platform and get them live as fast as possible. Our customers rely on Workist's AI software to automate core processes in Sales and Procurement. SAP is where the majority of that data lives, thus we need to tightly integrate with SAP. In this role you'll combine product engineering with hands-on project work, and you'll be the person who makes our SAP integration scale.


Your responsibilities

You own the SAP side of the Workist integration and are an important part of the customer journey, from the first technical workshop through go-live and beyond. You proactively identify process and product improvements.
 

  • You develop, maintain and customise our SAP integration for S/4HANA and ECC customers
  • You run and manage customer implementation projects, from requirements workshops to go-live
  • You are the technical counterpart for our customers before and after signature, making sure our software is compatible with their existing SAP landscape and compliant with data protection requirements
  • You work closely with our Product & Engineering team to align the SAP integration with our product roadmap
  • You analyse and identify new use cases that create measurable value for our customers


Your profile

We're looking for you as a professional team player who feels at home in an agile working environment where we share knowledge and push each other to deliver the best possible result.

  • You have at least 3 years of professional experience as an SAP developer or consultant
  • You are proficient in ABAP and ABAP Objects, and have built both reports and complete packages
  • You are confident with API technologies such as OData and REST
  • You know what SE80 is and feel at home in it
  • You have experience or a strong interest in working with AI to solve valuable business problems — an AI-first mindset
  • You have excellent communication skills and solid project management skills
  • You love developing yourself continuously, working independently and making your own decisions
  • First experience with Python, OData service development or SAP BTP is a plus
  • You speak fluent German and English (native or at least C1) 


Our benefits & culture

  • WorKi Tower: Our hip office in the heart of the city over 8 floors invites you to work professionally at an ergonomic workplace and gives you space for your creativity. Our own Workist Lounge awaits you with a cozy atmosphere including coffee, drinks and a vitamin basket for short or longer creative breaks. Play table tennis, darts or Nintendo to clear your head and exchange ideas with other teams.
  • Flexible working hours: Shape your working day with our flexible working hours. Have important appointments in the morning or evening? No problem, take advantage of work schedule flexibility.
  • Office, Remote & Workation: You decide yourself and have the flexible choice between a hip office or remote from your favorite location! We give you the freedom to work 4 weeks a year from abroad. Your state-of-the-art hardware will accompany you on your way!
  • Come-Together: Let's play together - let's celebrate together! End the working day with a cool drink in our lounge or enjoy the time with your colleagues at the summer party, Christmas party or our quarterly team events.
  • Stay fit & healthy: Your fitness is important to us, so join our weekly RunningLunch and connect with your colleagues. Work-life balance and reduction of your stress level included.
  • Stay mobile: Choose between Deutschlandticket Job and a JobRad allowance and be mobile throughout Berlin and/or Germany.
  • Be social: For your heart's project or to get involved in social and volunteer work, we support you with 3 additional "Social Days".
  • Further your education - with a personal development budget of EUR 1,000.00 per year.

title: Working Student AI Support & Operations
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Statworx
description_html:
About us

statworx is a leading Data & AI Consulting and Development company in the DACH region. For more than a decade, we have been helping organizations succeed with consulting, development, and training – delivering over 1,000 successful projects for more than 100 clients across nearly every industry.

From AI strategy to implementation, we develop innovative solutions. With expertise in AI Strategy, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data & AI Engineering, and AI Infrastructure, we support organizations throughout their entire AI transformation journey.
Our goal: Creating value from Data & AI. 

Our AI Development department serves as a facilitator for Data & AI transformation. We are taking a holistic approach, from the initial evaluation of AI maturity, through the design and development of data and AI solutions, to the practical implementation and scaling of AI solutions. Through our deep expertise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, we ensure that our clients gain the maximum value from their data.


Your tasks

Focus: Technical support and troubleshooting for LLM and AI applications in client projects

  • You support users with technical questions related to LLM and AI applications and handle support requests at L1 and L2 level
  • You analyze technical issues in a structured manner, identify potential root causes, resolve them independently where possible, and escalate more complex cases to the appropriate experts
  • You communicate clearly and professionally with users in German and English and ensure transparent handling of their support requests
  • You work primarily with Langdock and develop a solid understanding of the platform and its underlying LLM and AI functionalities
  • You document recurring questions and solutions and contribute to the continuous development of our knowledge base
  • You actively contribute insights from day-to-day support to continuously improve our support processes, documentation, and Langdock Support Bot
  • You collaborate closely with our technical teams and gain practical insights into the production use of modern LLM and AI solutions for our clients
  • You initially support a specific client project and will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to additional AI support and client projects in the future


Your profile

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science & AI, Business Administration, Economics, Business and Economics, or a comparable field and have a strong interest in technical topics
  • You have a solid technical understanding and initial hands-on experience with digital applications, technical tools, or support processes
  • You are interested in LLMs and modern AI applications and have already gained practical experience using relevant tools
  • Initial experience with Langdock is a plus, but not a requirement
  • You approach technical problems systematically, are able to narrow down potential causes, and enjoy independently familiarizing yourself with new topics and tools
  • You bring a strong hands-on mentality and take a pragmatic approach to solving problems rather than simply passing them on
  • You are able to explain technical topics clearly and communicate professionally and service-oriented with different types of users
  • You work reliably, thoroughly, and in a structured manner and maintain a clear overview even when handling multiple support requests in parallel
  • You have very good German and English skills at least at C1 level


Our offer

  • Data & AI at the core: Work on diverse and challenging projects with leading clients across various industries – from data-driven solutions to innovative AI applications
  • Professional variety & growth: Tackle complex, multifaceted questions and continuously expand your expertise in your field as well as in the broader Data & AI landscape
  • Continuous development: We support your methodological, professional, and personal growth through regular feedback, tailored learning opportunities, training formats, and our mentoring program
  • Culture & collaboration: You’ll be part of an open, diverse, and respectful work environment with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and a strong sense of team spirit
  • Modern ways of working: We embrace an iterative, modern work culture based on clear communication, ownership, and room for new ideas and creative freedom
  • Transparent compensation: We offer fair, structured, and transparent salary bands that are regularly reviewed and aligned with market and performance developments
  • Flexible work setup: Our modern Frankfurt office serves as your main workplace – while giving you the flexibility to work remotely on a regular basis and up to four weeks per year from within the EU
  • Mobility & well-being: Benefit from a subsidized Germany Ticket and discounted access to sports and wellness offerings through Wellpass
  • Equipment & extras: High-quality IT equipment (e.g., MacBook Pro), regular team events, childcare support, and attractive employee discounts complete your package


Your application

Simply apply via the application form and attach your current CV including a description of your methodological skills. We will contact you as soon as possible. If you have any questions on your application, you can reach us at ----- is particularly important to us is that we value the uniqueness of each person and always treat each other as equals. Different backgrounds, attitudes and ideas enrich us and form the basis of our success. That's why we welcome every application - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity.

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Webshop-, ERP- und Warehouse-Tools – vom Frontend bis zum Backend.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Funktionen mit Technologien wie React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt, TypeScript und Node.js.
  • Du hilfst dabei, Schnittstellen zwischen Webshop, ERP, Versanddienstleistern und Lieferanten weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Abläufe durch Software und Automatisierung verbessern können und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von Prozessen aus Lager, Versand und Einkauf.
  • Du arbeitest mit modernen KI- und LLM-Tools und unterstützt bei deren Einsatz für z. B. Belegerkennung, Datenextraktion oder die Automatisierung von Workflows.


Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Informatik, Software Engineering, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung, idealerweise mit React, Vue oder TypeScript.
  • Du hast Interesse an Fullstack-Entwicklung und möchtest deine Kenntnisse im Frontend und Backend weiter ausbauen.
  • Grundkenntnisse in Datenbanken und APIs sind von Vorteil.
  • Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Software reale Geschäftsprozesse wie Lager, Versand, Einkauf und Buchhaltung abbildet.
  • Du hast Lust, neue Technologien auszuprobieren und dich beispielsweise mit KI- und LLM-Anwendungen zu beschäftigen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und gerne im Team.
  • Du bringst Neugier mit und hast keine Angst davor, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.


Warum wir?

  • Wertschätzung und Teamgeist: Wir schaffen ein unterstützendes Umfeld, in dem deine Passion und Eigenverantwortung geschätzt werden.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit in einem dynamischen Umfeld: Hier kannst du deine Ideen sofort umsetzen und aktiv zum Erfolg beitragen!
  • Persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung: Bei uns hast du hervorragende Aussichten auf berufliche Weiterentwicklung - wir setzen auf den langfristigen Aufbau unseres Teams.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Wir honorieren deine Arbeit mit einer Vergütung, die sich sehen lassen kann.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Modernes Arbeitsumfeld, mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten sind unser Standard.
