title: Senior Reliability Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at RobCo
description_html:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Senior Reliability Engineer (m/f/d), you are the technical authority ensuring system-level robustness and long-term endurance across our modular robotic platforms. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it. Working cross-functionally across hardware design, physical testing, and field operations, you will translate messy real-world data into actionable design changes and world-class reliability standards.

Your Responsibilities

  • Direct the multi-year reliability and endurance test roadmap, serving as the technical authority for the physical test team executing it.

  • Close the loop against field and service data, translating operational insights into optimized maintenance intervals, spare-part strategies, and concrete design changes.

  • Own system-level reliability across our core products and module families, building Reliability Block Diagrams (RBDs) to aggregate component data into module-, arm-, and system-level reliability targets at defined confidence levels.

  • Set reliability requirements early and rigorously enforce them during design reviews to actively shape and refine the product architecture.

  • Drive failure mode identification by leading DFMEA and FMEDA sessions at system and module levels, while spearheading root-cause analyses for real-world failures.

  • Execute deep statistical analyses, calculating MTBF/MTTF for random failures and L10/B10 wear-out life for bearings, gears, and brakes while defending underlying assumptions.

  • Evaluate data integrity with sharp engineering judgment, knowing precisely when data is decision-grade versus a placeholder to guide leadership decisions.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or comparable experience.

  • Several years of experience in reliability engineering focused on complex electro/mechanical products.

  • Strong ownership and growth mindset, pragmatic working style and analytical rigor to reach defensible conclusions from incomplete evidence.

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus).

  • Practical command of RBD modeling, MTBF/MTTF prediction, L10/B10 life calculation, and hands-on FMEA/FMEDA experience.

Nice to have:

  • Background in robotics, industrial automation, automotive, aerospace, or medical devices.

  • Domain knowledge of servo drivetrains (gearboxes, bearings, brakes) and their specific failure modes.

  • Familiarity with functional safety standards (ISO 13849, IEC 61508, IEC 62061, or ISO 26262) or standard series like IEC 60300, IEC 61709, or SN 29500.

  • Experience with specialized reliability tools and software (ReliaSoft, Isograph, Windchill Quality, SISTEMA, Minitab, or Python/R) and applying Weibull analysis to messy real-world data.

  • Experience working with modular or configurable product families where reliability must be calculated per configuration.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and depending on the role, the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events, from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

In dieser Schlüsselrolle bist du eine tragende Säule unseres Finance-Teams und sorgst für finanzielle Präzision, Compliance und Skalierbarkeit.   • Du begleitest die Migration unseres ERP-Systems und den Aufbau der internen Buchhaltung, mit dem Ziel, die Prozesse 2027 vollständig inhouse abzubilden.

  • Du verantwortest das Intercompany-Management zwischen RobCo GmbH und unserer US-Tochtergesellschaft, stellst eine einheitliche Bilanzierung über beide Standorte sicher und koordinierst die Buchhaltung mit unserer US-Tochter.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Controlling, Personalabteilung, Supply Chain/Operations und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und triffst Entscheidungen auch dort, wo Prozesse noch nicht bis ins Detail definiert sind, statt auf explizite Vorgaben zu warten.

  • Du bringst Belastbarkeit und Gelassenheit für eine wachstumsbedingt unruhige und sich wandelnde Organisation mit.

  • Du kommunizierst offen und direkt, auch bei Fehlern oder Rückfragen, und passt damit zum direkten, unternehmerischen Arbeitsstil unseres CFO und der Geschäftsführung.

  • Du benennst fachliche Wissensgrenzen offen und findest eigenständig eine Lösung, anstatt bei kritischen Rückfragen auszuweichen.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1).

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung und Steuerung von Inventuren (Stichtags- und permanente Inventur) sowie in der Bestandsbewertung, idealerweise inklusive unfertiger Erzeugnisse.

  • Operative und praktische, nicht nur überwachende Erfahrung in der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, du kannst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mitbuchen, wenn es die Situation erfordert.

  • Erfahrung im Intercompany-Accounting und in der Zusammenarbeit mit US-Tochtergesellschaften von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung mit gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware bzw. ERP (z. B. DATEV, Odoo, Moss, Ramp) sowie Offenheit für die Begleitung eines ERP-Systemwechsels.

  • Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, technologiegetriebenen oder wachstumsstarken Unternehmen ist von Vorteil.

Warum RobCo?

  • Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation und regelmäßiges 360°-Feedback ermöglichen schnelle Entscheidungen und unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Eine geförderte Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft (über 7.200 Studios in ganz Deutschland).

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein modernes Büro und – je nach Funktion – die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents – von entspannten Bier- & Pizza-Abenden auf der Dachterrasse bis hin zu gemeinsamen Erlebnissen bei Skiausflügen oder auf dem Oktoberfest.

Our Audit Quality Agents help audit firms use AI with greater trust, consistency, and professional oversight. Built around auditing standards and review workflows, they enable firms to deliver more reliable and reviewable work while increasing capacity across the audit process.

  • Go deep into context to truly understand user problems

  • Are comfortable in early-stage startup chaos. High autonomy, high ambiguity, high speed

  • You've founded a company or shipped a serious AI side project

Interview process

  • First Call: Intro to Cortea with our Founders Associate Liza

  • Third Call: Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder & CEO Valentin

title: Chief of Staff (m/f/x)

description_html:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin-based startup rebuilding how audits are done.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we’re at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea’s future, and how audits are done.

 

The role

This isn't an administrative or "assistant" role. As Chief of Staff, you are a core member of the leadership orbit. You will work directly with Valentin (Co-Founder) to translate high-level vision into operational reality.

You will sit at the intersection of Growth, Strategy, Finance, and Operations. Your mission is to tackle the most complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t yet have a home, whether that’s architecting our international expansion, refining our AI-driven unit economics, or managing the machinery of a Series B fundraise.

This role is a springboard. You will gain a "CEO-level" view of building a category-defining AI company.

 

What you’ll do

  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact projects from conception to completion (e.g., designing an AI-era pricing model, spearheading entry into new European markets, or optimizing the sales-to-onboarding funnel).

  • Fundraising & IR: Act as the primary engine behind investor relations and future funding rounds, preparing the narratives and data rooms that will fuel Cortea’s growth.

  • Scaling the AI-Native Operating System: Build the repeatable processes, meeting cadences, and communication loops — supercharged with AI agents and automation — that allow Cortea to scale toward €100m+ ARR without losing speed. You'll treat internal workflows as products, deploying AI wherever it removes friction.

  • Founder Force Multiplier: Act as a proxy for the founders in internal and external meetings, ensuring decisions are made and projects stay on track even when the founders aren't in the room.

     

Who you are

  • 4+ years of experience in high-velocity environments (Top-tier Strategy Consulting, Investment Banking, or a high-growth VC-backed startup).

  • Strategic Operator: You can think at 30,000 feet about market positioning, but you have the grit to dive into a spreadsheet or a legal contract to get a deal over the line.

  • Financial Fluency: You have a deep understanding of P&L management, financial modeling, and SaaS metrics.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You can distill complex AI concepts and financial data into clear, persuasive narratives for investors and the team.

  • High Agency: You don’t wait for a playbook; you write it. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of a "zero-to-one" environment.

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and German (C1+) is essential for this Berlin-based role.

 

How we work

  • Founder mindset: Everyone acts like a founder. You’re encouraged to take on any topic you believe is worth improving, with team and founder support.

  • Thoughtful decision-making: Collaborative problem solving, concise written thinking, and deep in-person discussions to reach the best result.

  • Speed over perfection: We value progress and learning, preferring strong 80/20 solutions over perfection.

description_html:
About Cortea

Cortea is building the quality layer for AI-powered audits.

Our Audit Quality Agents help audit firms use AI with greater trust, consistency, and professional oversight. Built around auditing standards and review workflows, they enable firms to deliver more reliable and reviewable work while increasing capacity across the audit process.

We're building an AI-native company from day one. We believe small teams, equipped with AI and empowered to move fast, can solve some of the biggest challenges facing the audit profession.

We're looking for our first Product Marketing & Content Lead to help define how the market understands Cortea, why firms adopt our products, and how we become the category-defining voice in AI-powered audit.

The role

This isn't a traditional marketing role.

As our first Product Marketing & Content Lead, you'll shape how the market understands Cortea and how our customers experience our products—from first impression to every product release.

You'll report directly to the VP Marketing and work closely with the founders, product, design, sales, and customer success teams. You'll have a seat at the table with the leadership team, helping shape our product narrative, go-to-market strategy, and category positioning.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning complex technology into simple, compelling stories. You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer communications, thought leadership, and our content engine.

You'll have significant ownership from day one and the opportunity to build this function as Cortea grows.

What you'll do

Own product marketing

  • Develop and continuously refine Cortea's positioning, messaging, and category narrative.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear customer value propositions.

  • Lead product launches and feature releases across every customer touchpoint.

  • Own customer communications around product releases, including release notes, feature announcements, newsletters, and adoption campaigns.

  • Build competitive intelligence and market insights.

  • Develop customer personas and messaging frameworks.

  • Create sales enablement materials that help our commercial team win.

  • Partner closely with Product to ensure launches are coordinated and impactful.

Build the content engine

  • Own Cortea's content strategy across all channels.

  • Produce exceptional thought leadership on AI, auditing, regulation, quality, and the future of professional services.

  • Interview customers and industry experts to uncover unique stories and insights.

  • Write and edit everything from blog articles to research reports and customer stories.

  • Develop AI-powered content systems that scale without compromising quality.

  • Build and maintain an editorial calendar that compounds over time.

Shape the category

  • Help establish Cortea as the leading voice in AI-powered auditing.

  • Partner closely with the VP Marketing on category strategy and messaging.

  • Support executive thought leadership across the leadership team.

  • Identify emerging market trends and turn them into compelling narratives.

  • Build signature content that becomes a reference point for the industry.

Drive commercial impact

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to improve customer education and product adoption.

  • Support demand generation with high-quality product marketing assets.

  • Scale organic growth through content and SEO.

  • Measure the performance of launches, messaging, and content.

  • Continuously gather customer insights and bring them back into Product and Marketing.

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Content Marketing, or a similar B2B SaaS role.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills.

  • Experience launching products and translating technical capabilities into compelling customer narratives.

  • Strong understanding of product positioning and messaging.

  • Experience creating content that drives measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent interviewing, research, and communication skills.

  • A highly proactive mindset with the ability to thrive in ambiguity.

  • Comfortable working directly with executives and cross-functional leadership teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in AI, enterprise software, or B2B SaaS.

  • Experience marketing products for professional services, finance, accounting, audit, or compliance.

  • Strong SEO knowledge.

  • Experience building founder or executive thought leadership.

  • Familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-native marketing workflows.

  • Experience building content operations and editorial processes.

You'll thrive here if you

  • Think like an owner.

  • Love understanding customers.

  • Care deeply about clear communication.

  • Enjoy simplifying complex ideas.

  • Prefer building over managing.

  • Are naturally curious and ask great questions.

  • Like working across Product, Sales, and Marketing.

  • Want to help define a new category—not just market another software product.

What success looks like

Within your first year:

  • Cortea has a clear and differentiated product narrative.

  • Every product launch has a repeatable go-to-market process.

  • Customers consistently understand the value of new capabilities.

  • Cortea is recognized as one of the leading voices in AI-powered audit.

  • Our content engine generates meaningful awareness, engagement, and pipeline.

  • Product Marketing becomes a core strategic function within the company.

Why join Cortea

  • Build one of Europe's most ambitious AI companies from an early stage.

  • Report directly to the VP Marketing and work closely with the founders and leadership team.

  • Own an entire function from day one.

Don't meet every requirement?

We know great candidates don't always check every box.

If you're excited about the role, passionate about storytelling, product marketing, and AI, and believe you can help shape the future of audit, we'd love to hear from you.

Show us something you've created that changed how people think.

description_html:
Build something that truly matters

At Cortea, we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively. Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.

We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.

This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters.

About the role

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.

This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.

Roughly 70% product, 30% brand. The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.

We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces

  • Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall

  • Own our brand designs and visuals

  • Evolve our visual identity and design system

  • Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets

  • Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards

  • Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions

You'll be great at this if you

  • Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS, ideally in fast-moving startups.

  • Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.

  • Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love. Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.

  • Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.

  • Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.

  • Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.

  • Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.

Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

What you will get

  • Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry from Berlin, with AI at the core

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro on what we do with Liza

  • Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Jonas

  • Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Co-Founder Valentin

  • On-site Day — Meet our full team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.

title: Financial Auditor / Wirtschaftsprüfer:in (m/f/d)

description_html:
Über uns

Wir sind Cortea, ein Berliner Startup, das Audits mit KI neu denkt. Klassische Prüfungen sind oft manuell, dokumentenlastig und binden wertvolle Expertenzeit während der Bedarf an Audits weiter steigt. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Software und spezialisierten AI Agents automatisieren wir repetitive Arbeit, damit Auditor:innen sich auf das konzentrieren können, was wirklich zählt: fundierte Entscheidungen.

Wir sind mit über 15 Mio. Euro von führenden VCs finanziert, haben ein funktionierendes Produkt im Markt und bereits zahlende Kunden. Jetzt skalieren wir schnell.

Uns treiben First-Principles-Denken, Geschwindigkeit, Vertrauen und Freundlichkeit an. Wir bauen Cortea gemeinsam, direkt vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office.

Die Rolle

Diese Rolle ist für erfahrene Audit-Professionals, die keine Checklisten mehr abarbeiten wollen sondern Systeme entwickeln möchten, die sie überflüssig machen.

Du bringst tiefes Praxiswissen darüber mit, wie Prüfungen wirklich funktionieren, und übersetzt dieses Wissen in strukturierte Logik, die unsere Software skalierbar ausführen kann. Du musst kein:e Entwickler:in sein. Aber du denkst klar in Prozessen, kannst komplexe Standards in konkrete Regeln zerlegen und hast ein starkes Verständnis dafür, wie ein belastbares, qualitativ hochwertiges Prüfungsergebnis aussehen muss.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Audit-Logik entwickeln. Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen aus ISA- und IDW-Standards in klare Workflows, denen unsere Software folgen kann. Du definierst die Regeln, das System wendet sie an.

  • Komplexe Dokumente analysierbar machen. Du gestaltest mit, wie unsere Software Verträge und Abschlüsse liest und interpretiert, etwa bei Leasing nach IFRS 16 oder Revenue Recognition. Du definierst, worauf das System achten und wann es Ausnahmen markieren soll.

  • Unabhängigkeit absichern. Du entwickelst Checks, die eine übermäßige Abhängigkeit von automatisierten Ergebnissen verhindern. So stellst du sicher, dass unsere Workflows mit IDW PS 210 vereinbar bleiben und Reviewer jederzeit die Kontrolle über das professionelle Urteil behalten.

  • Dokumentationsqualität verantworten. Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Systemergebnis sauber in die Prüfungsakte integriert werden kann, im Einklang mit IDW PS 450 und belastbar für Qualitätskontrolle und Peer Review.

  • Cortea extern vertreten. Du nimmst an Branchenveranstaltungen teil, wirkst an Fachpublikationen mit und bringst dich in Gespräche mit Regulatoren zur Rolle von Technologie in der Prüfung ein..

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Abschlussprüfung mit, idealerweise aus Big 4 oder einer führenden mittelständischen Prüfungsgesellschaft. Du hast auf Prüfungsleiter-Level gearbeitet und weißt, was Mandatsverantwortung und Haftungsrisiken in der Praxis bedeuten.

  • Du kennst IDW PS, ISA und HGB sicher und kannst Standards in klare, reproduzierbare Prozesse übersetzen.

  • Du denkst in strukturierten Schritten. Du musst nicht programmieren können, aber du kannst Entscheidungsbäume skizzieren, benötigte Inputs definieren und beschreiben, wie ein korrektes Ergebnis aussehen muss.

  • Du willst den Berufsstand mitprägen — nicht nur den nächsten Karriereschritt machen, sondern etwas bauen, das verändert, wie Prüfungen durchgeführt werden.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch auf muttersprachlichem oder nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau.

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Nahtlose Umsetzung: Wir arbeiten fokussiert, schnell und mit hohem Anspruch an regulatorische Exzellenz. Sorgfalt ist für uns kein Hindernis, sondern die Grundlage für verlässlichen Fortschritt.

  • Qualität by Design: Wir glauben, dass systemgestützte Konsistenz Reviews entlastet und die Verlässlichkeit des Prüfungsurteils stärkt.

  • Intellektuelle Ehrlichkeit: Wir diskutieren tief, logisch und offen. Wenn ein Feature professionelle Skepsis gefährden könnte, denken wir es neu.

Was wir bieten

  • Impact: Die Chance, die Tools zu bauen, die du dir in der Prüfung immer gewünscht hättest.

  • Wachstum: Der Wechsel aus der klassischen Prüfung in eine wachstumsstarke Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Audit und KI.

  • Vergütung: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und relevante Equity-Beteiligung.

     

Interview-Prozess

  1. Intro call mit Liza (Founders Associate)

  2. Fachliches (Audit-) Interview mit Philipp, Co-Founder.

  3. Strategic & Collaboration Fit mit Valentin, Co-Founder.

  4. On-site Session in Berlin: Eine gemeinsame Session in unserem Berliner Office, in der wir eine „Reviewer-First“-Oberfläche entwickeln mit Fokus auf maximale Transparenz, Nachvollziehbarkeit und professionelle Skepsis.

title: Laser Optics R&D Program Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Focused
description_html:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Laser Optics R&D Program Engineer to join our team and help us shape the future of energy. This person will lead several R&D programs covering our laser and optical efforts with external partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Own multiple concurrent R&D programs end-to-end: scope, schedule, budget, risks, and deliverables covering areas such as optical coatings, nonlinear crystals, and advanced optical technologies. Drive milestone gates, purchase orders, and go/no-go decisions with full accountability.

  • Manage a multi-vendor portfolio of specialist optics and crystal suppliers developing different technologies, operating at different wavelengths, and sometimes competing on the same problem. Maintain confidentiality between suppliers where required.

  • Work with architects and physicists to define test campaigns and qualification specifications — ensuring they are properly scoped, resourced, and scheduled before handing off to the lab for execution.

  • Provide supervision and mentorship to laser engineers and laser technicians responsible for experimental execution, data collection, and test reporting. Ensure data quality, protocol compliance, and timely delivery.

  • Identify findings across programs — consolidating experimental results, vendor deliverables, and comparative analyses into clear recommendations for leadership and actionable specifications for vendors.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and decisions across all stakeholders — leadership, technical teams, and external partners — keeping everyone aligned without over-burdening them.

Who you are:

  • Master's or PhD in Optics, Laser Physics, Photonics, Materials Science, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in optics, photonics, or laser technology — sufficient to engage credibly with suppliers and internal experts on coatings, nonlinear crystals, and laser components.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multi-partner R&D projects, coordinating external suppliers, research services, and internal teams simultaneously.

  • Experience steering technical work packages and coordinating lab activities — you don't need to run every experiment yourself, but you need to know what good looks like.

  • Strong orientation toward practical outcomes and industrialisation: able to translate technical results into vendor specifications and programme decisions.

  • Fluency in English; self-directed, structured, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Preferred: Experience with laser-induced damage threshold (LIDT) testing or optical lifetime and reliability characterization.

  • Preferred: Knowledge of advanced or emerging optical coating technologies

  • Preferred: Experience working with external optics suppliers and/or photonics research institutes

  • Preferred: German and/or French language proficiency

What we offer:

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: We believe work should adapt to your life—not the other way around. That’s why we offer a hybrid setup, giving you the freedom to work from our office while also enjoying the flexibility to work from home when it suits you.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a subsidized canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 15% on top of your monthly contributions.

  • Equipment: Choose between a state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptop. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Laser Architect (f/m/d)

description_html:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage.

This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization.

The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built.

What you'll do:

  • Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE.

  • Explore alternative architectures and assess their feasibility through modeling and experiments.

  • Maintain ownership of the global architectural vision, even as individual subsystems evolve in parallel.

  • Define the laser R&D roadmap, including critical component development/evaluation, integrated beamline demonstrators, and intermediate testbeds

  • Work closely with experimental teams to ensure results feed back into architectural decisions

  • Support design of diagnostics and test protocols aligned with future scaling needs.

Who you are:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, optical engineering, or related fields

  • Deep expertise in high‑energy and/or high‑average‑power laser systems

  • Strong background in laser system modeling and scaling analysis

title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Focused
description_html:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.

What You'll Do

  • Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment

  • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for scientific data — including preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and deployment

  • Ability to communicate model behavior, confidence intervals, and limitations clearly to physicists, engineers, and non-ML specialists

  • Strong cross-functional team skills; comfort working in an interdisciplinary environment spanning physics, engineering, and software

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) or neural operators (DeepONet, FNO) applied to physical systems

  • Background in laser physics, plasma physics, high-energy-density science, or related complex physics domains

  • Experience with digital twin platforms and live integration of ML models with simulation environments (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Siemens Xcelerator, ANSYS Twin Builder)

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) workflows, including Design of Experiments (DoE), sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty propagation

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to physical system control or optimization

  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo methods and statistical uncertainty quantification frameworks

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) in a scientific computing context

  • Interest in fusion energy, advanced laser systems, or high-energy-density physics

title: (Senior) Controller
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HEY THERE

We’re looking for a Senior Controller to join Yazio and take full ownership of our controlling function as we continue to scale. You will bring structure, rigour and depth to our monthly close, accounting operations and internal controls, setting the standard for how controlling operates at Yazio. At our current stage, with around 150 employees, the decisions you make around close architecture and accounting design will have a long-lasting impact and will shape how Finance operates for years to come.

You will own and continuously improve our core accounting and controlling processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting and act as the in-house authority on technical accounting topics. Working closely with FP&A, Legal, Operations and external partners, you will support both day-to-day execution and complex accounting questions around new products and transactions.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal, or the U.K.

YOUR MISSION

  • Build, own and drive the monthly close end-to-end, ensuring fast, accurate and well-coordinated financial reporting with Accounting and key stakeholders

  • Review and sign off on accruals, cut-off entries, reconciliations and reporting packages for Management and FP&A

  • Act as the primary go-to for technical accounting questions, supporting new business models, contracts and complex accounting treatments

  • Develop and maintain technical accounting documentation and position papers (for example, revenue recognition, capitalization, leases and other complex topics)

  • Manage and coordinate external partners including accountants, tax advisors and auditors, ensuring strong documentation quality and smooth collaboration

  • Continuously strengthen internal controls by spotting anomalies, following up on open items and improving control effectiveness over time

  • Drive process and system improvements to reduce manual effort, increase close efficiency and build scalable, well-documented workflows

  • Use AI tools to support analysis, variance explanations, audit preparation and accounting research—while ensuring full critical review and accountability for outputs

  • Build a modern, scalable finance function through automation, standardization and continuous improvement

YOUR PROFILE

  • Several years of hands-on experience in Accounting, Controlling or Financial Reporting, ideally in fast-scaling environments with increasing complexity

  • Prior experience leading or coordinating a small accounting team is a plus

  • In-depth knowledge of German HGB; IFRS exposure is a plus

  • Proven ownership of the full monthly close cycle, ensuring accuracy, completeness and high-quality reporting end-to-end

  • Strong internal controls mindset with the ability to proactively identify risks, design controls and continuously improve processes

  • Advanced DATEV skills and confidence working with accounting systems and financial data

  • Comfortable using AI tools to enhance productivity (for example, research, documentation, anomaly detection, reporting support) while applying strong critical judgment on outputs

  • Structured, documentation-first working style with a strong focus on audit readiness and transparency

  • Strong drive for process improvement with a sharp eye for inefficiencies and scalable solutions

  • Proven stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating with external accountants, tax advisors and auditors

  • Growth mindset and a proactive approach to staying up to date with changes in accounting and tax regulation (e.g., HGB, VAT and IFRS)

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • A few lines (or a short video if you prefer) about who you are and why you want to work at Yazio

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

title: B2B Partnerships & Influencer Marketing Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HALLO

Bist du bereit, die Zukunft von B2B-Partnerschaften im DACH-Markt und darüber hinaus mitzugestalten?

Wir suchen einen Partnerships Manager mit Drive, einem starken Netzwerk und einem tiefen Verständnis für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Du erkennst spannende Kooperationsmöglichkeiten, gehst proaktiv auf potenzielle Partner zu, entwickelst überzeugende Konzepte und verhandelst Partnerschaften, von denen beide Seiten profitieren.

Dabei übernimmst du den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über Verhandlungen und Kampagnen-Launches bis hin zum langfristigen Beziehungsmanagement. Du analysierst, was funktioniert, optimierst kontinuierlich und skalierst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, Chancen erkennst, bevor andere sie sehen, und aus guten Ideen messbare Ergebnisse machst, könnte das dein nächster Step sein.

Diese Rolle ist zu 100 % remote und offen für Kandidaten mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal oder Großbritannien.

DEINE MISSION

  • Du baust strategische Partnerschaften in der DACH-Region und auf internationalen Märkten auf, entwickelst sie weiter und skalierst sie – von klassischen B2B-Kooperationen bis hin zu Influencer- und Creator-Partnerschaften.

  • Du identifizierst spannende Partner, sprichst sie proaktiv an und führst sie vom ersten Kontakt über die Verhandlung und das Onboarding bis hin zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Partnerschaftskonzepte und Kampagnen, die zu unserer Marke, unseren Zielen und den jeweiligen Partnern passen.

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – inklusive Verhandlungen, Briefings, Freigabeprozessen, Onboarding und laufendem Beziehungsmanagement.

  • Du bewertest potenzielle Partner anhand von Brand Fit, Zielgruppe, Content-Qualität und relevanten Performance-KPIs.

  • Du entwickelst neue Partnerschaftsmodelle und Kampagnen mit einem besonderen Fokus auf B2B-Partnerschaftensowie Revenue-Share-Kooperationen mit Influencer und Creators.

  • Du misst die Performance deiner Partnerschaften, leitest konkrete Insights ab und optimierst bestehende sowie zukünftige Initiativen kontinuierlich.

  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse innerhalb des Partnerships-Teams weiter und nutzt Automatisierung und Workflow-Optimierung, um effizienter zu arbeiten.

  • Du behältst auch die operativen Details im Blick – von Vertragsmanagement und Dokumentation bis hin zu Rechnungsstellung und administrativen Prozessen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen und Projekte reibungslos umgesetzt werden.

  • Du repräsentierst das Unternehmen auf Branchenevents, Konferenzen und Networking-Veranstaltungen und baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus.

  • Je nach Bedarf unterstützt du bei Influencer-Events und Creator-Aktivierungen.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Partnership-Management mit und kennst den DACH-Markt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, B2B-Partnerschaften aufzubauen, zu verhandeln und langfristig zu entwickeln.

  • Erfahrung mit Influencern, Creators oder Content-Partnern ist ein großes Plus.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, souverän und authentisch und hast ein natürliches Talent dafür, Vertrauen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen.

  • Du hast ein Growth Mindset: Du bist neugierig, ambitioniert und möchtest Dinge nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist kreativ und kannst aus einer Idee ein konkretes Partnerschaftskonzept oder eine Kampagne entwickeln.

  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld wohl.

  • Networking liegt dir: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, baust schnell neue Kontakte auf und pflegst dein Netzwerk aktiv.

  • Du bist proaktiv und selbstbewusst in der Ansprache potenzieller Partner – egal ob auf Events, per Telefon, LinkedIn oder E-Mail.

  • Du bringst starke Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, Win-Win-Situationen zu schaffen.

  • Du bist energiegeladen, hands-on und hast echte Begeisterung für Partnerships, Influencer Marketing und die Creator Economy.

  • Du interessierst dich für Social Media, Content, Influencer Marketing und die Entwicklung der Creator Economy.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kannst dich sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich sicher ausdrücken. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Wir suchen jemanden, der beide Welten versteht: den strategischen Aufbau wertvoller B2B-Partnerschaften und die Entwicklung von Kampagnen, mit denen Menschen tatsächlich interagieren möchten.

Dein Background könnte in Partnerships, Influencer Marketing, Creator Marketing, Brand Marketing, Business Development oder einer Kombination daraus liegen. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein exakter Jobtitel, sondern dass du Beziehungen aufbauen, Chancen erkennen und Partnerschaften in messbare Ergebnisse verwandeln kannst.

WARUM WIR?

  • Ein spannendes Produkt mit Millionen von Nutzern in über 150 Ländern, angetrieben von unserer Mission, die Welt durch gesunde Ernährung zu verändern

  • Ein Remote-First-Setup: Arbeite zu 100 % von zu Hause aus, nutze einen Co-Working-Space oder arbeite mehrere Wochen im Jahr im Ausland

  • 30 Urlaubstage zum Entspannen und Auftanken, plus 5 Kind-Krankheitstage, falls dein Kind dich braucht

  • Eine fokussierte Unternehmenskultur, die Effizienz über lange Arbeitszeiten stellt – keine Überstunden-Erwartungen, und falls doch, bekommst du diese Zeit zurück!

  • Ein wirkungsstarkes Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit echten Wandel bewirkt – kurze Entscheidungswege und kein Mikromanagement

  • Eine Teamkultur, in der Ambition und Ausgeglichenheit Hand in Hand gehen, unterstützt durch starke Verbindungen – von unserem vollständig finanzierten Firmenretreat bis hin zu Team-Meetups und virtuellen Kaffeepausen

  • Tools und Unterstützung, um deine beste Arbeit zu leisten: MacBook, Monitor und ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 €, dazu regelmäßiges Feedback und Karriereentwicklung

  • Ein wirklich internationales Team mit Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und einem gemeinsamen Bekenntnis zu Wachstum und Wohlbefinden – unterstützt durch Sunday Supplements und Nilo Health

DIVERSITY UND INKLUSION

Bei YAZIO glauben wir, dass Vielfalt Innovation antreibt. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem sich jeder – unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Fähigkeiten – wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlt. Wir feiern unterschiedliche Perspektiven und ermutigen aktiv Menschen aus allen Hintergründen, sich zu bewerben.

STARTKLAR?

Bist du bereit, YAZIO auf die nächste Stufe zu heben und Menschen weltweit dabei zu helfen, gesünder zu leben? Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören! Bitte sende uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch

  • Ein paar Zeilen (oder gerne ein kurzes Video), wer du bist und warum du bei YAZIO arbeiten möchtest

  • Zusätzliche Materialien, die deine Arbeit zeigen (z. B. LinkedIn-Profil, Portfolio)

title: Account Executive - Mid Market

description_html:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About The Role

We're looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to build and close pipeline in our larger accounts. Bigger deals, more people in the room, and a real commercial case to make. You'll own it end to end, from the first cold conversation to signature.

You'll build your own pipeline into named accounts, work with the SDR team on coverage, and run the full cycle from there: multi-threading across the account and building the commercial narrative that gets AI search visibility onto a team's budget. We are defining the category, so part of the job is teaching the market what good looks like, not waiting for a buyer who already knows they need this.

What You'll Do

  • Own and run the full sales cycle from first meeting to close across mid-market accounts

  • Multi-thread across marketing, SEO, growth, and procurement stakeholders, and build the business case that gets a deal signed

  • Generate your own pipeline into named accounts, and partner with SDRs and Marketing on targeted outbound and ABM across the patch

  • Keep the CRM and pipeline organised, with a strong handle on forecasting and deal progression

  • Share customer feedback and work with product and engineering to shape what we build

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in a quota-carrying software sales role, closing mid-market deals end to end

  • A consistent track record of overachievement against quota

  • Experience running multi-stakeholder deals, including building business cases and navigating procurement

  • A builder of your own pipeline: you can point to closed deals that started with your own prospecting, not a lead that landed in your inbox

  • Excellent communication skills and a natural ability for storytelling

  • Comfortable selling in a category that is still being defined, where you shape the buyer's thinking rather than respond to an existing budget line

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling SEO, analytics, or martech software

  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment

  • A track record of selling to marketing, SEO, or growth buyers

  • Repeatedly achieving president's club

What We Offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Paid Meal and Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €110K – €130K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

description_html:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About The Role

We're looking for an Account Executive - SMB to run our high-velocity sales motion. This is a volume seat: short cycles, fast decisions, and a lot of deals in flight at once. You'll generate a large share of your own pipeline and work alongside the SDR team on the rest, then take every deal from first conversation to close.

This is a role for someone who prospects as seriously as they close. If you want volume, a fast feedback loop, and a market that is moving with you, this is the role.

What You'll Do

  • Own and run the full sales cycle from demo to close across a high volume of SMB accounts

  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, and partner with the SDR team on coverage across your patch

  • Run efficient, repeatable discovery and demos that get a prospect to a decision quickly

  • Keep the CRM and pipeline clean, with accurate forecasting across a large number of concurrent deals

  • Share customer feedback and work with product and engineering to shape what we build

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a quota-carrying, full-cycle closing role in B2B SaaS

  • A consistent track record of hitting quota in a high-volume, short-cycle motion

  • A self-starter on pipeline generation: you have built your own and can point to deals that came from your own prospecting

  • Excellent communication skills and a natural ability for storytelling

  • Comfortable with high activity levels and running many deals at once without letting things slip

  • Highly coachable, and quick to apply feedback from one call to the next

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling SEO, analytics, or martech software

  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment

  • Experience with outbound tooling such as Clay, Apollo, or similar

  • Familiarity with the SEO, content marketing, or digital analytics space

What We Offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Paid Meal and Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €90K – €110K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

What you’ll do

  • Build, mentor, and lead an elite data science team as a trusted, empathetic player-coach, while clearly communicating complex technical ideas to executives, customers, and partners

  • Personally design, train, deploy, and own the models that power Peec AI’s AI Search recommendations, taking hands-on responsibility for our most business-critical ML systems

  • Own the full ML lifecycle end-to-end — from first-principles research and rigorous experimentation to production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement

  • Architect and evolve scalable data and ML systems, making high-leverage decisions across data pipelines, modeling approaches, evaluation frameworks, and model serving

  • 8+ years of professional data science experience, with at least 3+ years in a leadership or managerial role at a top-tier high growth startup, or FAANG level tech company (e.g., Tech Lead, EM, SDM)

  • A world-class data science leader with a rare combination of deep technical mastery and proven leadership, who has built and shipped category-defining ML products in high-growth or frontier environments

  • A demonstrable history of personally owning and scaling complex ML systems from raw research ideas to reliable, high-impact production deployments

  • Exceptional command of Python and applied machine learning, with strong systems-level instincts spanning APIs, data pipelines, ML infrastructure, and production reliability

  • A deep, first-principles understanding of LLMs and AI search systems, including the ability to rigorously evaluate, reverse-engineer, and reason about emergent model behavior

  • Experience making consequential architectural and modeling decisions in cloud-native environments (preferably GCP), using tools like FastAPI, Docker, and modern data platforms

  • Outstanding judgment, communication, and problem-solving ability, with the credibility to set direction, earn trust, and lead through extreme ambiguity

Our Data Science Stack

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Libraries: Pandas, NumPy, HuggingFace, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX

  • Backend: GCP, Cloud Functions, Firestore, Postgres, AlloyDB, BigQuery

  • AI Models: OpenAI, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Llama, and others

Bonus Points

  • Widely recognized contributions to open-source projects or foundational ML tooling

  • Publicly visible side or research projects demonstrating exceptional technical depth

  • Publications or talks at top-tier ML or AI conferences

  • Founder experience or senior technical leadership in high-growth startups

  • Fluency in TypeScript

What we offer

  • A defining leadership role with with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Aggressive equity compensation package

  • Paid Dinner & Uber home when working late

title: Operations & Strategy Working Student - Compliance
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at bunch
description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

You'll join our Ops team right at the intersection of compliance and strategy. Alongside our Fund Compliance Manager, you'll get hands-on with recurring regulatory reporting cycles across a fast-growing portfolio of fund clients, and as you find your footing, you'll get real opportunities to contribute to the process, tooling, and automation work that shapes how the whole team operates. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a task list and left on your own; it's one where good ideas about doing things better are actively wanted.

Your Role

  • Get hands-on with monthly German compliance reporting, Bundesbank reports, AIFMD filings, and FATCA/CRS cycles across a diverse portfolio of fund clients. You'll see how regulation actually works in practice, not just in theory.

  • Collect, review, and verify data and documentation from various stakeholders across our fund clients, spotting inconsistencies, missing pieces, or red flags before they become bigger problems. You'll take ownership of the workstreams that keep this data accurate and our compliance process running smoothly. Think of it as detective work with real regulatory stakes.

  • Beyond the day-to-day, you'll have real opportunities to shape the bigger picture - improving tracking tools, documenting processes, and contributing to automation initiatives that our compliance team is actively driving forward. As you settle into the core workflows, these opportunities naturally grow alongside you. Good ideas here don't just get heard, they get built.


About you

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented and thrives in structured environments

  • Previous experience in banking, legal, or regulatory-related roles is a strong plus, though genuine interest in financial services or fund operations matters just as much if coming from a different background

  • Proactive mindset and strong risk awareness — notices when something's slightly off before it becomes a real problem, and knows when to raise it early

  • Currently enrolled in a related field such as business, law, or finance

  • Structured, detail-oriented working style paired with genuine curiosity about the reasoning behind a process

  • Comfortable owning recurring responsibilities, and just as comfortable questioning and improving them

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and German

  • Comfort with Excel, ideally with some familiarity with tools like Notion, Asana, or Google Sheets

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Make your mark in a mission-driven FinTech startup that values each of its bunchies

  • Be mentored by experienced operators and founders, that take your development seriously

  • Work from an amazing office right in Berlin-Mitte and be part of a welcoming and motivated team

  • Learn fast in a culture that values ownership, creativity, and trust and always strives to empower others

  • Additionally enjoy benefits in mobility, food and learning

  • Take part in a network of people passionate about investment and work closely with the most interesting players in the private market.

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.


____

At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.

description_html:
At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We're looking for a proactive Working Student to support our Operations team in a dynamic, growing environment. You'll help coordinate projects, improve processes, and ensure teams stay aligned while gaining practical experience across production, procurement, and testing activities.

Your Roadmap to make an Impact

  • Support cross-functional projects by gathering, consolidating, and maintaining project data, ensuring clear visibility of progress, open tasks, and potential risks.

  • Coordinate with production, procurement, and program teams to follow up on open topics, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure smooth communication between stakeholders.

  • Assist in improving operational processes by identifying inefficiencies, contributing ideas, and supporting the implementation of scalable solutions.

  • Provide hands-on support in the preparation, coordination, and execution of test campaigns.

  • Contribute to strategic operations projects, including the development of scalable test planning and verification frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives across the Operations team.

  • Help maintain project documentation, track action items, and support reporting to ensure timely project delivery.


  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Structured and analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with cross-functional teams.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with a willingness to take ownership and follow up on open topics.

  • Genuine Interest in operations, manufacturing, testing, and continuous process improvement.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
